90690.description:
Turalyon reports the Vanguard of the Light is prepared to march on Xal'atath's stronghold.

Would that I could join you for the charge. I will keep my retainer of forces here to maintain the defense of the Sunwell and Silvermoon while you take the fight to our enemy. 

Muster in the Voidstorm, take the fight to the Voidspire, and bring an end to this great enemy. Good hunting.
90690.title: Charge of the Vanguard

90701.description:
Goblins love bombs, I get that. But does EVERYTHING have to blow up?

Do me a favor: In the next Dastardly Duos match you enter, find a cheery bomb inside one of the wooden tree and planter props.

After you find the bomb, but before it  "blows up"... smack it for me. Don't worry, they're cowards.
90701.title: Cowardly Cheery Bombs

90705.description:
Are you curious about your world's history? Would you like to learn more?

Li Li Stormstout has started her Lorewalking apprenticeship. With all her travels, she has gathered many stories of important events and figures across Azeroth and beyond and is eager to share them!

Pay her a visit in your capital city!
90705.title: Lorewalking

90718.description:
Ah, {name}!

I hear you have a standing invitation to Archmage Khadgar's... Arcantina?

Can you go there for me and bring this missive to the Archmage? I need to source reagents for the sheer volume of telemancy spells I have been asked to conjure.

Magister's Terrace has been an excellent source up until recent events but really I need the Kirin Tor to loan me some of their harder to find ingredients.
90718.title: Request of the Arcantina

90719.description:
Adventurer, I have made an amazing discovery. 

Analyzing the memories from the time I have discovered that I might be able to recreate the corruption effects that have been wielded in the past. Albeit in a much more controlled way. 

I will need you gather some black blood residue from defeating the bosses of the Corrupted or Lost areas of the map and a few more of the displaced corrupted mementos.
90719.title: Borrowing Corruption

90724.description:
All those people. Our army. Our heroes. Our leaders.

Gone.

We are exposed here. Umbric's tether saved us, but we need to ensure we survive this. Report to Lor'themar and tell him what transpired in the Voidspire. I will get Umbric to safety and learn what I can here.
90724.title: The Broken Sky

90729.description:
Not everything you recovered yesterday was mine, but let's be honest--we're going to keep it anyway!

Xy'daz has been ripping people off for years. It's his turn to take a loss!

Now, this can work in both our favors. You sell off half of the leftover goods for me, and I'll let you keep the rest!
90729.title: Win-Win Situation

90731.description:
Welcome back adventurer. I have made a new discovery but I need to test it out. 

Hidden in the Lost areas of the Horrific Visions I believe is a rare black blood coagulate. This might be the key to increasing the power of the corruption effects... in a safe way. 

If you can go into these areas and find this item and also bring me back more displaced corrupted mementos I should be able to increase the potency of the corruption effects.
90731.title: Enhancing Corruption

90733.description:
Now that you've learned about our legends, you've earned the notice of one of our elders. He wants to meet you.

His name is Aksem, and he knows things that the rest of us have never learned. History that remains hidden, even in the paintings.

Go and introduce yourself. He's expecting you.
90733.title: The Listener

90734.description:
The high priest Aksem has asked for you again. He said you are not the only one on a quest for knowledge about the deep history of Harandar.

Go to him. I believe he already has another guest who is also interested in learning this hidden history.
90734.title: In the Name of the Goddess

90735.description:
This time, I do not have a story for you. 

Instead, Aksem has asked that you meet with him to help recover the next of the relics. Go to speak with him, and he will tell you more of what you must do.
90735.title: The Stolen Staff

90736.description:
The rutaani in the Blossoming Terrace are crafty. They've trained their petalwings to search and grab anything shiny that rolls down from the Den.

And, I suspect, sometimes they grab things that haven't naturally fallen.

So we want to get those things back. That's where you come in.

Go into the terrace, and don't hesitate to use force to send a message. That's a language we all understand.
90736.title: That's Not Yours

90737.description:
You're looking for a staff called the Root of the World. It's a powerful twist of woven roots, back from before the haranir traveled deep into the mountain.

It's irreplaceable, as Aksem knows. So if a rutaani petalwing stole it, that's embarrassing. The only way for everyone to save face is to get it back.

Search the nests of the bigger birds. They've been trained to look for more valuable items.
90737.title: Nested Clues

90738.description:
When the haranir first arrived in Harandar, they brought with them a staff formed of the roots of a great tree. That tree has since gone away, but the roots remain.

It has been our duty to protect that staff and pass it on through the generations, but now it has been stolen.

Your task is to find it and return it to Zur'Ashar Kassameh.

Go into the mists below the Den and seek out the Shul'ka. They will guide you on your search.
90738.title: To the Blossoming Terrace

90739.description:
Looks like you didn't find any sign of the rootstaff among all the thiever's nests. That's a good thing, honestly.

But there's more to this test than just recovering stolen goods. Yes, it's a test. You're seeking secret knowledge. That means something here doesn't add up, and the real answer is waiting to be found.

So, come find me when you're ready to get that answer.
90739.title: The Root of Things

90740.description:
I am entrusted with many secrets, and the benefit of that is not having to explain myself often.

You have recovered the Root of the World, as I asked. Now, take it to Zur'ashar Kassemeh, and learn more about it.

There will be more for you, later.
90740.title: A Legend to Know

90741.description:
Aksem has asked for you again. He says he's ready for you to undergo the final ritual for the knowledge he wants to teach you.

I admit, I'm envious, but I do not envy the trials you'll need to undergo in order to prepare for this knowledge.

Go speak to Aksem, and do as he says. Orweyna will be joining you.
90741.title: Once More Into the Rift

90742.description:
As you know well by now, the creatures in the rift are infused with the essence of Aln'hara. What we need is that essence mixed with water.

Aksem wants us to collect water here and then infuse the essence of Aln'hara into it. I can only imagine what it might be used for.
90742.title: Shrouded by Aln'hara

90743.description:
You know the dangers of the Rift of Aln, but this is the best place to prepare for the kind of ritual Aksem wants to perform.

Go about the rift and place offerings to prepare yourself.
90743.title: Ritual Reinforcement

90744.description:
We have prepared ourselves as best we can for the next stage. Now, we must venture into the deepest part of the Rift of Aln.

Into the Dreamrift.

It's a place so dangerous that even the Shul'ka hesitate to go, but we must. Aksem needs us to collect the most powerful infusion of Aln there is.

Are you ready?
90744.title: The Dreamrift: Malformed Mystery

90745.description:
You have ventured far, fought deep, and learned many things about our history to be here.

Now it's time to know the truth. Prepare yourself.
90745.title: The Empty Cradle

90746.description:
The time for preparations have passed. Xal'atath's forces are upon us.

Join us, champion, as we must rebuff this assault and then press our attack on the Darkwell.
90746.title: The Elves Assemble

90747.description:
We may have gotten off on the wrong foot, but there's something you should know.

That old slateback you used to haul all those imports? I thought it was just another worn-out nag, but it turns out it was the real treasure all along.

A rare bluecephalus, worth a fortune!

You might want to figure out where it went, and why Ba'eth isn't exactly rushing to share the profits!
90747.title: The Wrong Bluecephalus

90748.description:
Champion, the time has come to see an end to the Darkwell.

I do not know what awaits us beyond the gates of Quel'Danas, but we cannot tarry any longer. The Void continues to pour into the Darkwell, transforming it. 

Arator is at the head of our combined armies. He has asked you and your strongest allies join him at his side. 

It is time to end this and take back our well.
90748.title: Quel'Danas

90749.description:
<Liadrin lowers her voice, speaking only to you.>

We have two choices. We can either continue to talk to the Amani or fight our way inside.

I would still prefer to negotiate passage with Zul'jarra, but if our diplomacy goes awry, be ready.

For now, follow my lead.
90749.title: Our Mutual Enemy

90754.description:
This land is more vast than I remember. However, a good scholar is always prepared.

To cover more ground, you will need a winged mount and the skill to ride it swiftly.

I recall Lord Andestrasz helping us with this in the past, near the Timeless Isle in Pandaria. Let's send you back to that moment in time, so you can learn from him.

Don't wander too far in distant lands, you're still needed back here. Return via the portal when you have finished your instructions.
90754.title: Skyriding

90755.description:
That should suffice for now. Remember the basics and you will improve in time.

Speaking of time, you had best be on your way. The portal there will take you back to Moratari.
90755.title: Time Flies

90759.description:
<A missive written on shimmering vellum unfurls before you.>

{name},

Rumors suggest that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, has been recruiting in Alliance cities. Meet me in Stormwind to investigate these rumors. If the cult is there, then we must stamp it out at once.

Magister Umbric
90759.title: The Cult Within

90760.description:
Apocalyptic threats have taken many forms in Azeroth's history, but today we face Xal'atath and her Twilight's Blade.

I fear that people are falling into hopelessness as the Radiant Song cries a warning. The Twilight's Blade could use that despair to draw them into their ranks.

My mages have identified this district as housing a peculiar amount of void energy. Investigate and stop any cultists you may find.
90760.title: Avoiding Blame

90761.description:
The cult of twilight has long been dedicated to ending Azeroth. That they ally with Xal'atath is no surprise.

If the Twilight's Blade are indoctrinating citizens, we must stop them. We cannot permit the weak to fall to the Void's dark designs.

The Cleft of Shadow is home to many practitioners of unsavory magic. Identify and end any cultists you may find there.
90761.title: Avoiding Blame

90762.description:
I've spoken with Grand Magister Rommath. Despite our differences, it seems we are aligned in purpose.

We have both found evidence that Twilight's Blade cultists are convening in the Twilight Highlands. It's a place long scarred by the cult's misdeeds. And it's a suitable staging ground for an attack.

Meet us there so we may continue our investigation.
90762.title: The Twilight Highlands

90763.description:
I've received word from Magister Umbric. He has found similar evidence that the Twilight's Blade are recruiting in Stormwind.

The Void poses an existential threat to all of Azeroth. We must stop the cult at its source.

We've agreed to meet in the cult's homeland, the Twilight Highlands. Find me there so we may continue our investigation.
90763.title: The Twilight Highlands

90764.description:
<A missive written on fine parchment unfurls before you.>

{name},

I have heard unsettling rumors that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, is recruiting within Horde cities. Meet me in Orgrimmar so we may root out this evil. We cannot suffer a single cultist within our walls.

Grand Magister Rommath
90764.title: The Cult Within

90765.description:
Cult activity in the area has risen significantly. While we are gathering troops, you secure a cultist disguise and infiltrate their nearby training grounds.

Find out anything you can about the Twilight's Blade and their goals. I will keep this area secure.
90765.title: Midnight Dress

90766.description:
It takes more than blistering desperation for the apocalypse to be part of the Cult of Twilight.

We are Xal'atath's Twilight's Blade. Our purpose is greater than it has ever been before. And thus, we must become her strongest allies.

Go and train with my associates in the field. Educate yourself on our rituals and rhetoric. Only then will I allow you to go through the initiation ceremony.
90766.title: Xal'atath's Proven Faithful

90767.description:
Having completed your training, you have earned full membership with the Twilight's Blade.

<Harrowtongue pauses a moment, appearing self-satisfied.>

As a member of the cult, you will now join your fellow acolytes in an initiation ceremony. They are in the basement of this building receiving instructions from our great leader, Mor'duun.

Allow his words to fill you with zeal for the cause. The end is near!
90767.title: More Doom

90768.description:
Mor'duun and his Twilight's Blade cultists are directly supporting the Harbinger's dark designs for our world.

And that is all we need to know. Kill as many as you can, then meet us back at our base of operations.

The cult and its leaders must be eliminated.
90768.title: Cult It Out

90769.description:
Why you want such a strange beast? 

I save many better items just for you. What about some soap?

But, I not deny {name} heart's desire.
90769.title: A Blue for You

90770.description:
Dey say you want the blue beast. Was a great bargain I stumbled upon. Da bazaar full of opportunities. 

Many more bargains to find in spots where treasures lie waiting. 

You know where to look?

Go to dis special place and find treasures, I give the blue beast to you.
90770.title: The Grift

90772.description:
De coal... it's white-hot now. And I feel like there is somethin' inside it?

Brek said dis was de last trial. But Jan'alai is not here.

What do we do now?

<Zul'jarra looks at Brek and scowls.>

Talk to Brek and see if he's got anything to say we can understand.
90772.title: The Flames Rise Higher

90773.description:
Since I am helping you, I'm sure you won't mind returning the favor.

I have a constant need for fresh, untainted meat, which is quite hard to come by. The Oasis is off limits, but the wildlife roaming these sands?

I've got a list of what I need. Bring me those items, and I'll tell you what you need to know.
90773.title: Meat My Business

90776.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>
90776.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat

90777.description:
Champion, the Sunwell holds for now, but the Vanguard has begun to deploy the bulk of its forces to Voidstorm.

Lady Liadrin has requested your assistance at the Sunwell.
90777.title: Feeding the Flame

90778.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>
90778.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility

90779.description:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash though your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?
90779.title: Cracked Keystone

90782.description:
<The draenei first tries to speak to you in his native tongue, adapting after you fail to respond.>

Men of Void take us to here. Come from sky. Fighting, killing. Want to go back. Help brothers and sisters.

Show you.
90782.title: The Nethersent

90818.description:
It is not unexpected to sense some fel magic here. There are still warlocks in the city and old fel siphoning chambers. But the evidence I've found so far is more than could be explained by just that. It feels... different. Chaotic.

This practice has to be widespread, which means someone must be talking about it.

I've been rooting around too long to go unnoticed, but perhaps you could covertly listen in on some idle banter around the city. If you learn anything useful, report back to me.
90818.title: Murder Row: Loose Lips

90819.description:
Based on what we discovered, I believe the fel is coming from Murder Row. Someone there is breaking down Legion relics and infusing the magic into mana wyrms for covert siphoning--and people are buying it up in droves.

We need to figure out who that someone is.

Take this wyrm core with you into the Row and look for more of them. The promise of coin should get you in front of the right person.
90819.title: Murder Row: Acting the Part

90821.description:
That manifest is stamped by the Silvermoon Harbor. It looks like Zaen has his smugglers working there to push his fel relic shipments through inspections.

If we cut off their supply line at the harbor, we can halt the fel operation until we track down Zaen and end it for good. No sense going after the middlemen until then.

Subterfuge got us this far, so let's keep at it. Head to the harbor and tell them you're picking up Zaen's shipment. We'll work from there.
90821.title: Murder Row: Harbored Secrets

90822.description:
We have all the puzzle pieces. Zaen smuggles fel relics from the Broken Isles by stacking the Silvermoon Harbor with his own smugglers. The relics are processed in Murder Row, then fel magic is infused into mana wyrms for sale and siphoning.

Such a convoluted operation might be impressive, if the goals weren't so reckless. Zaen is preying on people's fear. He doesn't care who he helps or hurts as long as he rakes in the gold.

Let us end it. We'll find the Illicit Rain in Murder Row and clear it out.
90822.title: Murder Row: One Fel Swoop

90823.description:
Now that I be catching my breath, I be reminded of why I thought there'd be nothing but silence at the top.

She be here. Akil'zon be here. But also, she had been gone when we needed her most.

What could she be wanting to tell us?
90823.title: Akil'zon's Insight

90824.description:
En'liahn saved me from the Rift of Aln. He's my older brother. I know it was stupid to go there, but it wasn't my fault!

We all thought En'liahn was dead, but I saw him earlier at the wetland. When he saw me, he ran away.

<Chua looks sad.>

No one here believes me and now I can't go. Will you help me find him again?
90824.title: My Brother's Alive!

90826.description:
I'd hoped Chua hadn't seen me. Better he thinks I died. Instead, I'm self-exiling.

I was trapped in the Rift of Aln while saving him. Being in there for so long corrupted my connection to the goddess--if I don't sever it soon, it'll drive me mad, or worse.

The Shul'ka who saved me has agreed to mentor me through the process. He told me to come here and gather some things for a ritual to sever the connection.

I must collect the nearby healing waters. Will you help me fill this jug?
90826.title: The Healing Waters of Ahl'ua

90827.description:
My Shul'ka mentor instructed me to collect the toxic glands from the creatures here. He said they were crucial to the Ritual of Severing in order to break my connection with the goddess.

<En'liahn shakes his head in pain.>

I'm not looking forward to whatever this ritual is, but her disjointed song in my head is getting stronger and making it hard to focus.
90827.title: Only the Poisonous Parts

90829.description:
I'm in your debt, {name}. I didn't think I'd get any help. My mentor only provides guidance. He says that is the way of the Shul'ka.

Thanks to you, I have everything I need for the ritual. Will you continue on with me? I'm heading for the cliffside overlooking the Rift of Aln to the northeast.
90829.title: Meeting My Mentor

90830.description:
The next step is to locate the ritual site. It's different for each potential Shul'ka.

Amarakk says that I must open myself to the power of the rift--that some part of myself tied to this place will guide the way.

All I can tell you is it hurts.

Are you still with me?
90830.title: The Path Will Reveal Itself

90831.description:
If En'liahn is to succeed as a Shul'ka, he must learn to disrupt the manifestations in the rift. Sometimes that means closing small tears as they open. Most of the time, we simply slay the manifestations where we find them so they do not become so numerous as to threaten the rest of Harandar.

It is a never-ending responsibility each of us bears. It is why we are Shul'ka.

This, of course, assumes that he survives the ritual, or even survives to find the ritual site.
90831.title: Doing Is Becoming

90832.description:
En'liahn is about to drink the mixture of the poison and healing waters to begin the ritual. He will be unconscious and fighting for his life.

The manifestations of the rift can sense this, and they are gathering.

{name}, you must place the wards and use their power to defend him while he severs his final connection to the goddess before her song drives him to madness.
90832.title: As Her Voice Goes Silent

90833.description:
Foolish. En'liahn is still weak from the ritual and not prepared.

He has run off to confront Morta'ka the Sundered Echo. This is the final rite of all who would become Shul'ka, but it is usually only attempted after years of preparation.

En'liahn will not survive, and in dying will only make Morta'ka more powerful. Will you save him, {name}?
90833.title: The Final Rite

90834.description:
I don't know how to feel about losing my connection with Aln'hara. There's no more pain... I'm not going mad, but there's a hole inside. Does that make sense?

Will you rejoin us back up on the cliff?
90834.title: From This Point Forward

90835.description:
I would advise exploring the city with caution. Not all is what it seems in Silvermoon.

The Illidari are performing an investigation which need not be spoken of openly. But you appear formidable... Perhaps you can aid us.

My commander, Belath Dawnblade, is heading the investigation. The last I heard, he was surveying the upper terraces of the Bazaar.

Seek him out, if you would make use of yourself.
90835.title: Murder Row: Rumors Abound

90837.description:
I have been sensing powerful fel magic throughout Silvermoon, but this is the first origin point I could locate. The rest were too faint, or perhaps deliberately hidden. Fortunately, this means we now have a specific area to comb through more closely.

We need to gather more evidence. Go around this area and see if you can find more hidden sources of fel. I will grant you a temporary portion of my sight so that even the slightest hint of fel magic will be obvious to you.
90837.title: Murder Row: Traces of Fel

90838.description:
You, stranger... do you know of the Shadowguard that left K'aresh in ruins?

My sister was lost in the conflict, her heart forcibly turned to the Void, but I swore oaths to my family... to cherish them no matter their transgressions.

My sister, Veraan, is surely lost, but if I were to recover her necklace, at least then my oaths would be upheld in spirit.

I am a simple tinkerer. I've tuned this device to track the Shadowguard, but I cannot face them alone.

Would you help me?
90838.title: Oaths and Heirlooms

90840.description:
The Dragon Isles is a dangerous and uncharted place. We'll need to get you prepared.

You're strong enough now that you should choose a combat specialization.

This will unlock a new array of abilities for you to face the dangers within the Dragon Isles.

Go ahead and choose your combat specialization.
90840.title: What's Your Specialty?

90842.description:
Before you head off, you'll want to get yourself a Hearthstone. 

This little stone will return you to the inn where you last bound it to.

It's not much of an "inn", but the explorers have a tent set up. 

Test out that new mount of yours and ride over to Sil'nori Crestshade. He'll get you sorted out with a Hearthstone.
90842.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is

90843.description:
It's time for us to part ways. I have pressing business further within the Dragon Isles in a place called the Azure Span.

Naleidea Rivergleam of the Dragonscale Expedition could use your help.

Safe travels, {name}. I look forward to our next meeting!
90843.title: Aiding the Dragon Isles

90844.description:
While I've been lurking, I've been listening.

These Shadowguard appear to have a minor rebellion on their hands. Some of the ethereals are acting erratically. They're being rounded up and questioned.

What's going on here?

Dispatch some of these Shadowguard and intercept their intel. I'll decode anything you bring back to me.
90844.title: Fits of Lucidity

90845.description:
I swore an oath to honor my family... difficult when my sister was converted to the Shadowguard. She may not be here, but tracking the Shadowguard has led me to this place. 

I'm looking for a necklace that belonged to my sister Veraan. It's odd... I've noticed many K'areshi heirlooms discarded around here. It seems the Shadowguard wish to destroy any reminders of our home world.

If you bring some of these trinkets and baubles to me, we can see if there are any I recognize.
90845.title: Distant Memories

90847.description:
Thanks to your intel, we have learned that the rebels are being interrogated by Questioner Xen'daan.

It is said that after being questioned, the rebel ethereals are being taken somewhere to be "dealt with."

The head questioner is sure to know more. If we can find where they've taken the rebels, there may still be hope for them.
90847.title: Truth From Power

90848.description:
Veraan is sure to be amongst the rebels taken to Shadowguard Point.

Her fiery spirit fills me with great pride!

I came here expecting to say a farewell of sorts. I did not come here expecting to find my sister.

Perhaps it's not too late, {name}!
90848.title: She Started the Fire

90851.description:
The Shadowguard seem to have no qualms caging and torturing their own kind.

The last thing I want is more violence amongst the people of K'aresh, but better them than us.

Disrupt their operation by subduing some of the Shadowguard.
90851.title: Eating Their Own

90852.description:
The betrayers are being held in stasis chambers.

I've seen these cages before. Their design is efficient but fragile. They will fail with the slightest energy variation.

Find crackling energy vessels strewn about and heave them at the stasis chambers. With true aim, you will disable them and free the betrayers.
90852.title: Techno-Magnetic Pulse

90858.description:
We were brought here to face the wrath of Soulbinder D'zaar. She commands the Shadowguard here. She leverages the power of the Voidstorm to convert souls to energy that she consumes.

She and her loyalists are traitors to our kind!

<Veraan grimaces in pain as the Void courses through her.>

They must be stopped... their devices dismantled... their will ended...

{name}... destroy them all!
90858.title: Repress the Oppressors

90860.description:
Rebels like us are brought to Soulbinder D'zaar. She suffers no betrayers.

Our fate was to be sacrificed--our souls converted to energy. D'zaar works the conduit with arcane mastery to absorb these souls!

We don't have much time. I can feel the Void pressing from within. If we are to leave this life violently, D'zaar and her conduit are coming with us!
90860.title: Shedding the Yoke

90861.description:
In the wake of Xal'atath's destruction, what remains of our forces are gathering at the Darkwell to determine what we can do about the remnants of the Void.

We cannot abide the presence of so much dark energy. Some of our greatest casters and most knowledgeable scholars believe they might have a solution, but we could use your aid.

Please, join Arator at the Darkwell at your earliest convenience.
90861.title: Those Left Behind

90862.description:
The last of the other elven leaders have returned with powers from their homeland that will help us in cleansing the Darkwell. 

While the Voidstorm no longer barrages the Darkwell, it still needs healing. 

Please meet with the other leaders and let them know we are ready for them.
90862.title: In Times of Need

90866.description:
To go home, water of life. Need.

<Tul'amar attempts to discern if you understand what she's talking about with a look. After a pause, she opts to stab her own fingertip with the end of her staff and then displays a bead of her blood to you.>

This. Of here. Is of fight. Of fight is Void. Void is power. With power, go home.

<She shows her fangs with an exaggerated snarl before pantomiming a claw swipe.>

Water of life. Of beast. Much. Yes?
90866.title: Universal Language

90867.description:
We will not let the Sunwell be corrupted again. This Darkwell must change, but it must change to something that we are no longer bound to with such dependency. We do not need this well to be the bait for so many other world-corrupting forces.

No, today we heal the Darkwell, and make it something new. Let me know when you are ready.
90867.title: From Darkness, Light

90869.description:
So, the higher-ups in the marketing department say you need a good partner to soften your aesthetic of... you know, "murder everyone around me for gold."

We've got two focus group approved goblins over there ready to go, so go take your pick. Sassy will handle the paperwork.

Oh, don't give me that look. You only gotta forever-love each other in front of the public. Once the cameras are off, no one cares. It'll be great for your reputation!
90869.title: It's All in the Image

90870.description:
Ah, ye're here! Brewfest is here and we've got a small problem. We can't have a proper feast without the food, but some pesky hozen thought it'd be fun to steal our bags of grub. I'm sure they're just lookin' to fill their own bellies, but it's messin' up our plans!

So here's what I need ye to do: hunt down those hozen and take back the bags they've snatched. There's a good chance ye'll find a few bags just sittin' on the ground too. When ye return, just add the recovered bags to that wagon back there.
90870.title: Gathering the Grub

90871.description:
Champion. 

After much discussion, negotiation, and even some screaming and three duels, the Sunreavers and the Silver Covenant have decided on a course of action to define both of our futures.

Given your aid in getting us to this day, we would like you here to act as a witness as we formalize and sign our peace accords. Will you do us the honor of igniting the Flames of Remembrance?
90871.title: The Silversun Compact

90872.description:
<Tul'amar looks away from the blood-soaked and mortified Juras, and toward the portal as it flickers to life. She reads it with her powers of the arcane.>

Good. Blood is vio... violent? Violent is power. Need more. Now, brothers and sisters.

<She gestures to the blood in your possession, and then to her people. Many of them return wary looks your way.>

You can. I say. 

Then, go out. See of me.
90872.title: Drenched In It

90873.description:
Brothers and sisters. Here. Help.

<Tul'amar connects her thumb and index finger on both hands to make a chain. Then, she breaks the link with a sharp gesture.>

How? Show.

<She then produces a glimmering relic and holds it over her gauntlet. She spends a portion of her arcane energy into it. Its newly activated magic forces the straps holding her glove in place loose.>

Use.
90873.title: These Violent Delights

90874.description:
Go home. How?

<She offers a dramatic flourish with her fingertips, producing some arcane sparks. Then, she makes an X with her index fingers.>

Of me? No. Of they.

<Tul'amar gestures to a group of voidwalkers up ahead. She then draws her thumb across her neck.>

Kill. And.

<She reaches into a pouch on her hip and retrieves a cracked stone of domanaar make. It looks like a spell reagent of some kind.>

As this. Need.
90874.title: Their Violent Ends

90875.description:
Man of Void. Have key. Need. Key to home.

<Tul'amar gestures down the way to the northwest. She grimaces back at her injured kin.>

Go back, we. Wait. Hope. For you.
90875.title: Across Worlds

90876.description:
Champion, I felt it was important to have you here for this moment so that neither I nor my wayward former peer get off topic with his many failings.

I also want a witness in case he turns to evil. 

Would you be so kind as to unpack a few items so that I do not have to touch them?
90876.title: Reluctant Hand

90879.description:
Now that ye've gathered the materials, we can get to cookin'! We'll need plenty o' food for the whole crowd.

We've got a short but sweet menu: Barley Soup, Pretzels, and of course a good ol' brew!

Are ye ready to learn the ropes?
90879.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen

90880.description:
Ye've done well in the kitchen, now it's time to learn how to serve! Brewfest isn't just about food--it's about makin' sure everyone has a good time.

Ye'll be takin' orders, deliverin' dishes, and pourin' drinks with a smile.

Get out there and show 'em how it's done. Brewfest won't run without good service!
90880.title: Serving with Style

90882.description: Handle those gnolls while we figure out our next move.
90882.title: Gnoll Way

90883.description: Find Farmer Bruvk outside of Go'Shek Farm.
90883.title: To Go'shek Farm

90885.description:
The kobolds and ogres appeared out of nowhere and kicked us out of the farm!

I thought this was some Alliance plot until you all showed up. Maybe the Alliance is here to help us after all.

You have to help me get my precious pumpkins back. I've spent the entire harvest cultivating them!

You lead the way. I'll grab the pumpkins when you find them.
90885.title: My Beautiful Pumpkins

90886.description:
The kobolds and ogres here seem to be carrying some sort of plan for their attack.

I don't think they're particularly well written, so I'll need several of them to figure out what the ogres are planning.
90886.title: Best Laid Plans of Kobolds and Ogres

90887.description:
Farmer Bruvk mentioned an ogre named Runk was leading the group here.

These creatures won't leave this place as long as that ogre is commanding them.
90887.title: Farmer's Nemesis

90888.description:
The plans you found indicate the ogres are trying to get food to supply a massive attack on Stromgarde Keep!

Or they're trying to use the crops to keep guarding an object named a storm. The translation was loose. 

It's safe to assume our problem is the former. Let's go!

target.name: Best Laid Plans of Kobolds and Ogres

90888.title: Saving Stromgarde Keep

90892.description:
<The skies are full of residual time energy and demons pouring in from other timelines.

I should help Eternus by cleaning up the skies. The extra bronze energy would be nice too.>
90892.title: Clearing the Skies: A Fel of a Time

90893.description:
We must do everything possible to stop this siege on Stromgarde. 

Make your way into the battle and weaken the ogre forces.

Stromgarde should be able to rally if they can gain the upper hand.
90893.title: Repelling the Siege

90895.description:
These catapults are relentless. They must be destroyed.

Place these rune stones at their base. It'll unleash arcane magic to turn the catapults to dust.

I'll take out a few as well as I make my way across the battlefield.
90895.title: Catapult Bombardment

90896.description:
The head of the siege is still cowering within the former Horde encampment. 

He managed to hide from Jaina's spell behind several of his cohorts.

You can have the honors to confront of him. Jaina and I will stay here to ensure any remnants of the siege do not return.

End this.
90896.title: One Last Ogre

90897.description:
I think we can count ourselves lucky there was no bigger threat here beyond a group of overambitious ogres. 

The same can't be said of other threats that are looming throughout Azeroth.

Come. Let's return to Stromgarde to discuss matters further.
90897.title: Back to Stromgarde

90898.description:
We're not always so lucky that a plan such as this is ended so swiftly and without a surprise portal or two.

That being said, more dangers lurk throughout Azeroth. I know you can be of help to some.

Let us return to Hammerfall to see how they're recovering.
90898.title: Back to Hammerfall

90901.description:
There's more to artifacts than meets the eye, {name}.

Simply using an artifact allows its legend to grow, and as that legend grows, so too does its power.

In order to unlock the full potential of that power, however, you'll need to focus infinite power into the artifact's traits. As more traits are empowered the artifact's true potential will be unlocked, and its legend will be undeniable.

Let's get started.
90901.title: As A Matter of Artifact

90907.description:
Notes speaking of fear, of uncertainty--of some mysterious truth? This is not good, {name}. By all accounts, it sounds as if a cult has managed to infiltrate Tranquillien. 

If that journal entry was true, Kasiea was attempting to leave it. 

We must tell Antenorian. He'll want to secure the town and make sure his people are safe.
90907.title: The First to Know

90910.description:
A dreadful presence calls from the den just to the southeast of here. Many of the dazed ren'dorei you see in camp were overwhelmed by its raw power on a scouting mission.

Let us go together and see if whatever dwells within can be put to use. We cannot afford to spurn power in the fight against Xal'atath.

Before that: we have little need of Kalgorg. The Voidstorm has made my voidwalker unruly and disobedient. Assist me in sacrificing it. We will need all of the Void energy we can muster.
90910.title: Overwhelming Darkness

90914.description:
Ah, {name}. I have so enjoyed our time together. I hunger for more. 

I wish you knew more of me than my predilection for the taste of mortal suffering. One of my greatest joys is in crafting Void power into various objects and structures. It is my passion--my art.

Here, I would like to show you. First, we will need power. You already know how to get it, of course: kill, kill, kill.
90914.title: A Born Killer

90915.description:
While we domanaar are best known for leading armies and savoring battles, there is more to us. 

Many, like myself, enjoy using our mastery over the Void to shape it into the buildings and objects you see around you. 

How do you think Xal'atath learned to create that great tower of hers? She's a quick study. 

Come now, and I will show you my work.
90915.title: Artifice of Aggression

90916.description:
It's no easy thing, intertwining Light and Void together. The result is unstable, so we must continue to temper it. 

We shall quench this blade in the blood of our enemies. 

Some domanaar attempt to reclaim and re-power Nexus-Point Xenas. That won't be good for your people. I'll assume you want to stop it. 

What is it you mortals say? Two birds, one stone?
90916.title: Seek to Destroy

90917.description:
The blade hungers! The blood of our enemies will help stabilize and hone our nascent weapon. 

You'll need to drench the blade inside some corpses. So, you'll need to make corpses. 

<Decimus's smile grows broader.> 

You're good at that, right?
90917.title: Harvester of Savagery

90918.description:
Since even before our little misadventure, Nexus-Point Xenas has always been the weakest link. The beasts here are stubborn and powerful, always pushing deeper and deeper in. 

Some domanaar seek to reclaim the Nexus-Point. They are known to me: weaklings, fighting for scraps. Let's ensure they fail.
90918.title: The Unforgiven

90919.description:
The blade squirms. It is ready for its next transformation.

There is only the leader, Vortensiun, left. 

He is known to me. Once, we formed a pact together to defeat a rival. When the time came for him to betray me, he did so clumsily. 

I let him live, so I could savor the taste of his regret. 

I wonder how well that pain has marinated by now? Let's find out. When the blade is tempered in his essence, it shall grow new power.
90919.title: The Fiend That Failed

90920.description:
Enjoying the view? 

The blade is stronger now, but it is not yet complete. A weapon worthy of you deserves nothing less than perfection. 

But let us relax for a moment. I understand you mortals enjoy a... casual exchange of conversation to get to know each other better.

I am familiar with the concept, but am curious to see it in action. Indulge me?
90920.title: Warmth for the Soul

90922.description:
<The shade flickers. You can barely make out its whisper.>

You... left me... to die...

<Its arm reaches toward you, then dissipates. Somehow, the presence is a familiar one. You feel that you know this spirit. 

You see more flickers in the distance. What are these shades?>
90922.title: The Fallen Wake

90923.description:
Our journey continues... one final battlefield. There are vicious beasts aplenty here. Their Void shall fuel the blade even more.

And the blade's newfound power shall draw their Void into itself by mere proximity!

Though, this place is different. You may find things you don't expect.

Keep an eye out.
90923.title: Shepherd of Fear

90924.description:
The time has come. The final step. 

<Decimus pauses, savoring something.>

Let us create the greatest weapon your kind has ever seen.
90924.title: The Wicked End

90938.description:
Fleshling, do you know about Untethered Space? I am sure you know someone who has encountered it. 
 
Previously we assumed that only beings of energy such as those from K'aresh could Phase Dive. Since the Harbinger's return, she has created a means for solid creatures to become energy using Reshii Wraps.
 
My name is Hashim, and I have some Reshii Wraps in my possession. We are in desperate need of adventurers powerful enough to brave the lucrative depths of Untethered Space.
90938.title: A Skip Through the Void

90957.description:
{name}, today is when you find your proper place among the haranir.

Root Tender Dalnir will guide you. His path is one of tradition and humility, so don't expect excitement. By the end of the day, you will make your mark in the Den of Remembrance. The story you begin now will build on those that came before, like the roots themselves, growing the foundations of Harandar.

Dalnir was clearing invasive drifters from the roots. Before you go to him, aid Dalnir by removing some of the pests yourself.
90957.title: Initiation Day

90958.description:
Some say the great trees grow, and Harandar will remain even if we do not tend them. Our traditions say, it does not matter. We remain here to protect, tend and serve. We do this with dedication and humility.

Keeping the environment around the roots clean and free of pests reflects upon this duty. Return to me once you are done. You will represent our ways well, {name}.
90958.title: Roots Above All

90959.description:
Dalnir has a point about the ceremony, but we should not focus too narrowly. I still hold the values of our people, but sometimes we must look beyond.

Do not worry. You should be focusing on the ceremony. I will search for the outsiders later.

I am sure you could join me once the initiation ceremony is done.
90959.title: Traditional Duties

90960.description:
{name}, the final part of the ceremony is ahead of you, though you've put it at risk with your digressions.

The first mural will show you a vision of your true self, the one that resonates from within you.

The second mural will show you a vision of where you are needed.

The third mural, tradition tells us, breaks the barrier between us and the Goddess herself.

The ceremony will conclude with you painting your story in the Den.
90960.title: My Story, My Legacy

90961.description:
{name}, I see you now for who you are. You are dedicated not just to our people, but to the world.

The goddess has acknowledged you as well, and I can not recall such an event--not even Orweyna's ceremony was so eventful.

This is where your story begins. It is time for you to take the first steps of your journey.
90961.title: Stranger in a New Land

90963.description:
Good work freeing the captured rutaani. With the seeds you recovered, I can try to carry on Ru'gar's work.

I did some scouting and gathering while you were keeping the fungarians distracted, and could use your help with another task. Meet me at the cave northeast of here.
90963.title: Caves of the Cleft

90968.description: Rumors are abuzz of titan forces being sighted around Khaz Algar. Brann has asked Dagran Thaurissan II for assistance in looking into these rumors.
90968.title: Titanic Rumblings

90969.description:
Adventurer, the rumors are true. I've seen the titan forces and they are nae friendly. We must try tae discover why they are emergin' now and try and stop 'em from doin' too much damage.

Confront and stop these renegade constructs. To help ye, I've procured some Titan Consoles. I was able to set them up in the affected areas. I can use them to communicate with ye in the field. I am thinkin' we can use them to counter these titan forces as well.
90969.title: Titan Consoles

90970.description:
We need tae secure more titan discs. Venture deeper into this area, seek out the Titan Constructs, and defeat them. Ye should find disc shards. This console can reassemble them and access their data. 

Make sure tae search for any treasure rooms as well. The constructs appear to be assistin' the local denizens. Some of those locals might've secured additional titan discs with their other treasures.
90970.title: Titan Disc-Count

90971.description:
With the shards ye found, we can use the console tae restore the titan discs and use them to access powerful boons. 

Use the console's disc repair feature to create a titan disc, then use that disc to select a starting node in the overcharge console's interface.
90971.title: Overcharged Console

90972.description:
{name}! I heard you were here on K'aresh. Good. I need help.
 
My apprentice Leona has been researching novel means of harnessing the power of the Void. She's approached a Demon Hunter named Adarus to see if the Illidari's methods could offer any insights.
 
To be honest, I'm not sure I trust Adarus. He's not... studious. Unlike Leona.
 
Leona was just going to observe him as he sought to master the Void. But she's disappeared. Please find her. Talk with Adarus--he knows something.
90972.title: A Common Cause

90993.description:
We have our army but what lies behind these walls are the most powerful, most vile, and most empowered foes Xal'atath has in her arsenal. 

Gather your strongest allies, {name}, and meet us within. It is time to end this and take back our well.
90993.title: Take the Darkwell!

90995.description:
Oh wait! Of course, right when I send you off I remember the most important thing!

The you-of-this-timeline made a critical choice for the future of all demon hunters. The follower they chose to be their personal champion created two diverging timelines for the fate of the Illidari.

You will need to choose which of these diverging timelines to explore. What rings true to you?
90995.title: The Future of The Fel Hammer

91000.description:
{name}, residents of Hammerfall have been focused on daily life, defense, and survival over the past months. 

They have not had sufficient time, or frankly numbers, to address all the harms that were done.

There is much we can do to help them get back on their feet.

I know this is humble work, but it makes a very real difference to the orcs who live here.
91000.title: A Humble Servant

91001.description:
With dey magic and dey line broken, de Twilight's Blade is losin' ground.

We must take advantage of dey turned backs.

I will lead de charge through de ravine to de Conquerer's Sanctum beyond. Mor'duun is there, keepin' his coward-body safe from our spears and axes.

He won't be safe much longer.
91001.title: Clear de Way

91009.description:
Adventurer, can you hear me? I've discovered a smaller titan device, the Durable Information Storage Container, which can fit on yer belt. I've deduced they'll be able tae play smaller titan discs, granting ye boons ye can use anywhere. 

Each of these devices need a jump start. If ye kick up enough dust in these delves it should generate a spark that the device will detect and collect. It should be enough tae power it for yer lifetime.
91009.title: Durable Information Storage Container

91026.description:
Hello? Hello? You're back! Perfect!

I was studying the titan console and gathering a bunch of new information from the overcharged areas including the faulty directives that were found. This might be the key to this unexpected behavior, but I'll need more time tae know for sure.

Return to the delves and we can check the results of the faulty directives, I can use the information to create an upgrade for yer belt!
91026.title: Gathering an Upgrade

91030.description:
My calculations need a lot more data. I've got another upgrade card nearly finished, but I'm not sure if it will integrate properly.

But if ye go back into the delve spaces and defeat more of the enemies, I can see how they react. Based on their reactions, I can put the final touches on this upgrade for yer belt.
91030.title: New Titan Directives

91031.description:
I realized after ye left last time that I might have worried ye a wee bit with the whole exploding belt upgrade possibility. I'm sorry. I get a bit excited sometimes.

I do think I can get even more power out o' the belt. At least a bit more. Safely of course! In yer data, I've seen that you've encountered many enemies as ye entered many delves. That's the key, return one more time for this last upgrade for yer belt.
91031.title: Pushing it to the Limit

91033.description:
Welcome back, adventurer. I have a simple request for ye. I need ye tae continue monitorin' these titan constructs. 

We have seen them moving around Azeroth in different locations, but I've not yet figured out their end goal or what instructions they might have. Perhaps if ye can gather more information, an insight will present itself.
91033.title: Monitoring 'Construct'ing

91035.description:
Yer previous results showed a reduction in the overcharge present in the constructs. We must see if that was a one-off or if the reduction is escalatin'...

Head back into these overcharged areas and test out the charge on the constructs, then report back.
91035.title: Construct De-Escalation

91038.description:
<A scorch-marked missive has been nailed to this wall.>

HELL COMES FOR YOU!

Now that we have your attention, please be warned that shards of brimstone have entered this world. They are warm to the touch and should not, under any circumstances, be stabbed into your head, the head of anyone else, or any other vital organ of you or anyone near you.

Please bring any shards you find IMMEDIATELY to us in Dornogal.

And if you see any tiny little minions carrying a bag of treasures, KILL THEM ON SIGHT.
91038.title: Hellhunters Wanted

91039.description:
{name},

Geya'rah and Danath have arrived in Dornogal. They both seem upset about rising tensions in the Arathi Highlands. It sounds serious.

Can you come to Dornogal? I believe your presence can help the situation.

Faerin
91039.title: Faerin's Request

91044.description:
I did all I could to prevent this outcome. If you hadn't pushed him through the portal the unrestrained void energy would've collapsed the cave around us.

He was strong. In a way, I think that worked against him.

Meet me back in Shan'dorah. I need to report to Umbric and let him know what happened here.
91044.title: Hunger of the Void

91052.description: Something has caused hostile titan constructs to activate and enter various caverns and spaces around Khaz Algar. Venture to these locations and investigate and eliminate the threat they pose.
91052.title: Worldsoul: Overcharged Delves

91061.description:
You may think this ironic, but our time is running short, {name}. Great forces threaten more than one world's future.

Nozdormu won't like it, but I must hasten our study with experimentation. I have isolated a fractured timeline for you to explore. But be warned--this realm is devoid of all hope. It is the only way I can truly prepare us for what is to come.

I have established a research console by the fel monument behind you. Use it to enter this forbidden future so that we may learn the unknowable.
91061.title: Infinite Chaos

91062.description:
I make one last request of you before you return with Liadrin to Silvermoon, hash'ura.

Find Zul'jan. None have seen him since returnin' to Amani'Zar.

On de way back here, I confronted him about takin' our soldiers to Broken Throne against my orders.

People died dat shouldn't have. I asked him what he don't understand about dat.

He didn't argue. He was blank. His body was there, but his mind?

Sometimes he seeks peace in de sound of ocean waves.

You might find him on de Skybridge.
91062.title: Broken Bridges

91063.description:
You're that stranger I've been hearing about, aren't you? I'm Su'meera, apprentice painter to Ja'kul. You heard of him? No? Maybe his work hasn't made it to your lands. That makes sense, I guess.

Anyhow, I heard you like helping people out. Well, a few important things went missing when Ja'kul was attacked and killed. I want them back.

Will you meet me near Blooming Lattice?
91063.title: The Blooming Lattice

91065.description:
A couple of days ago, a group of rutaani attacked and killed my mentor, Ja'kul. When they did, their stupid birds stole a few things from him. Those petals-for-brains will make off with anything shiny that isn't thorned down.

Will you recover Ja'kul's things for me? I'm a painter, not a fighter. I wouldn't last very long in there on my own.
91065.title: Purloining Petals

91066.description:
Good, you've brought the supplies. Now, we begin the feast. We'll need plenty of food to keep up our strength.

The menu's simple, but worthy: Barley Stew, Stone-baked Pretzels, and a strong brew to fuel the Horde!

Are you prepared to learn?
91066.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen

91067.description:
Ah, you're here. Brewfest has begun-but we've got a problem. Can't have a proper feast without food, and some thieving hozen thought it'd be clever to snatch our grub.

Here's what you'll do: track down those hozen and take back what's ours. You might find a few bags just lying around too-grab those. Once you've got the goods, toss them in the wagon behind me.
91067.title: Gathering the Grub

91068.description:
You've proven your strength at cooking, now it's time to prove it on the floor! Brewfest isn't just about feastin-it's about bringing the revelry to every corner of the camp.

You'll be taking orders, hauling plates, and pouring ale like a true warrior of celebration.

Now get out there and show them what real service looks like! Brewfest don't run on empty mugs!
91068.title: Serving with Style

91069.description:
Me and Tolbani had loaded de skiff with medicine, steel, and food to bring upriver to de forward camp.

It was meant to be a quiet run: no trouble, and no eyes on us.

But in de shallows, de murlocs came swarmin' out of de reeds all foam and teeth. Dey hit us hard--too fast to fight back proper. We tipped and lost de cargo. I barely made it to shore.

Tolbani didn't. I dragged his dart-riddled body here.

De murlocs must pay for what dey have done.
91069.title: Vengeance for Tolbani

91070.description:
While I was limping back from de river, I spotted a few of de murlocs dragging our food bags through de mud. They weren't working together either--kept snapping at each other, trying to snatch de best pieces for themselves.

I saw one of them stash a whole satchel behind a fallen tree. Another buried something under a pile of rocks. Greedy little monsters think they can steal from us and get away with it.
91070.title: Reclaim the Goods

91071.description:
Our boat didn't ground on its own.

We were fightin' de murlocs, and then suddenly we were in de air.

Dats when I saw him--one dat wasn't like de rest. Bigger. Stronger. When he attacked, de other murlocs scattered.

He picked up our boat like it weighed nothin' and hurled it on de rocks. I've never seen a murloc do somethin' like that.

We're gonna keep losin' people and supplies if dat muscle-bound murloc is watchin' de river.
91071.title: The Menace of Atal'Abasi

91084.description:
Though we've triumphed over Ruia and the Lightbloom for now, more remains to be done. The elders will want to convene regarding the Hara'ti's new place in the world, now that we have stepped out from the shadows of our past.

Our reticence and fear will not vanish overnight. But this is an important first step.

We will be fine, {name}. Let Orweyna and I deal with the elders. When the time comes, the Hara'ti shall be at your side. For now, though, I'd imagine you have more pressing matters to attend to.
91084.title: Looming Shadows

91085.description:
Ja'kul was out hunting petalwings when the rutaani came upon him and killed him. We use their feathers for some of our paintbrushes. They are especially useful in helping the young sprouts learn how to be more precise and delicate. 

While you're up there, will you bring me back some of their plumes?
91085.title: Petal Bristles

91086.description:
The rutaani of Blooming Lattice were behind the attack on Ja'kul. They're led by a Prime Bloomwarden who's even more vicious. I hate them and they're all terrible!

How about you go prune the overgrowth and make the rest of us safer?
91086.title: Nipping the Buds

91087.description:
I will go to Silvermoon but... I will return here to advise Zul'jarra.

I feel I let my past and my prejudices get in the way of my judgement regarding the Amani. You could say that being a hash'ura is a befitting atonement but... I feel drawn to stay, perhaps to help Zul'jarra in guiding her people back to the loa.

I will go to Silvermoon with you to bear the report--and Lor'themar's reaction.

If we go now, we may return to... party.

<A small smile cracks Liadrin's usually stoic face.>
91087.title: Reports Returned

91088.description:
The scroll you brought back was left behind for me by my mentor, Ja'kul. I didn't even have a chance to read it before it was stolen away! 

Ja'kul left directions in the scroll to a cave that's behind a waterfall in Blooming Lattice. I'm not sure what we'll find there, but I would really appreciate if you came along while I check it out. Will you meet me there?
91088.title: Behind the Falls

91089.description:
So she's here to collect a bounty, eh?

Did nae one tell her it's rude to try and kill a Champion of Azeroth? Or a Bronzebeard, for that matter?
91089.title: Defeating Ky'veza

91090.description:
Nearby creatures are suffering an infection of Light, and are being drawn to the Sunbath. Our guests find it disturbing. That is a problem, when one is trying to enjoy a tranquil escape from the world.

I confess, having one run into your leg while you are swimming can be unnerving.

Please, dissuade the invading sungrubs from joining us, and take to the sky to chase off those persistent butterflies.
91090.title: Pesky Pests

91093.description:
Untethered Space represents an ongoing danger to our people on K'aresh. It is infested with banished souls, broken technology, and monsters of all kinds.

Aid the K'aresh Trust and defeat our foes in Untethered Space. You may use the Phase Conduits to navigate between the remnants of K'aresh while phase diving.
91093.title: More Than Just a Phase

91095.description:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.
91095.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Normal)

91096.description:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.
91096.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Normal)

91097.description:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.
91097.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Normal)

91098.description:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, {name}? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.
91098.title: Prey: L-N-0R the Recycler (Normal)

91099.description:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.

Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.
91099.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Normal)

91100.description:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.
91100.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Normal)

91101.description:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.
91101.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Normal)

91102.description:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.
91102.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Normal)

91103.description:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.
91103.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Normal)

91104.description:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with. 
 
There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...
91104.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Normal)

91105.description:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.
91105.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Normal)

91106.description:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.
91106.title: Prey: The Wing of Akil'zon (Normal)

91107.description:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.
91107.title: Prey: Ranger Swiftglade (Normal)

91108.description:
I do not know what to make of Lieutenant Blazewing. Her entire patrol disappeared during a reconnaissance mission into Zul'Aman. She was the sole survivor, but she returned with a fiery bloodlust and a complete disregard for the lives of others. 

Whether this is possession or sedition I am unsure, but she must be dealt with.
91108.title: Prey: Lieutenant Blazewing (Normal)

91109.description:
Reports are coming in of shredded Farstriders adorned with petals and berries--entire patrols found strung up by razor-vines. There are more gruesome details, but they chafe even my... refined sensibilities. 

Hunt whatever manner of creature is embarking on this horrific killing spree, and see to it that its anguish is added to our crystals.
91109.title: Prey: Petyoll the Razorleaf (Normal)

91110.description:
Do you garden, {name}? I've been known to dabble. It seems the plants in our realm are becoming somewhat overbearing these days, sprouting legs and arms and running around murdering our brave soldiers. 

Let's give them a bit of a pruning, shall we?
91110.title: Prey: Lamyne of the Undercroft (Normal)

91111.description:
High Vindicator Vureem is a victim of his own unyielding faith in the Light and the superiority it gives him. His crusade continues unabated and unresolved. He exists in a constant state of fury at the imperfectness of the world and those within it.

In the absence of total purity, Vureem sees only violence and the shadows of his own dogma. 

What say we put his worldview to the test?
91111.title: Prey: High Vindicator Vureem (Normal)

91112.description:
We are not sure if Luxia Maxwell is a deserter or has simply decided to embark on her own personal crusade. Regardless, reports are coming in of her attacking both friend and foe alike, yelling aphorisms of purity and duty.

She has become a liability to the defense of Silvermoon. 

Go and harvest her anguish.
91112.title: Prey: Crusader Luxia Maxwell (Normal)

91113.description:
The domanaar...

<Astalor shudders.>

I do not profess to know much about them, other than their proclivity for subterfuge, guile, and the absolute destruction of anything that stands before them. Praetor Singularis is no exception. They have been confounding our forces at every turn.

Go and put an end to their games.
91113.title: Prey: Praetor Singularis (Normal)

91114.description:
I have heard that there is one under Xal'atath's command who takes particular delight in dominating their foes. Whispers of a domanaar that taunts its victims with whispers and riddles before annihilating their mortal coil with void magic.
  
Consul Nebulor is their name.

Go and show them the limits of their power.
91114.title: Prey: Consul Nebulor (Normal)

91115.description:
The domanaar have a reputation for guile and cunning, but there are brutes among them: those who seek to dominate their victims through sheer power and force of will.

Executor Kaenius is one such domanaar.

They stalk the battlefield, singling out our strongest soldiers and viciously cutting them down.

Put an end to their rampage.
91115.title: Prey: Executor Kaenius (Normal)

91116.description:
Imperator Enigmalia is personally responsible for the deaths of at least a dozen Farstriders. I say "at least" because this particular domanaar makes it somewhat difficult to identify the bodies, so utterly destroyed are they.

Go and avenge our fallen soldiers.
91116.title: Prey: Imperator Enigmalia (Normal)

91117.description:
Death knights are unstable killing machines at the best of times. Knight-Errant Bloodshatter has forsaken any oath or promise that would ostensibly bind one of his kind to the bottom rungs of civilized society, and has gone completely rogue.
 
He is starting to become a liability. 

Recoup his anguish so that we can make the best of such an unfortunate situation.
91117.title: Prey: Knight-Errant Bloodshatter (Normal)

91118.description:
Vylenna the Defector lives up to her name. After a recent engagement on the field of battle, she became so preoccupied with profaning the dead that she completely abandoned the duties ascribed to her.

Then her dereliction turned violent.

A veritable font of anguish if you ask me...
91118.title: Prey: Vylenna the Defector (Normal)

91119.description:
Those of us who succumbed to our base desire for mana were slowly weeded out of civil society, if they survived at all. Theldrin is one such example, only it is a testament to his cunning and will to live that he has made it as long as he has.

He accepts no aid, choosing instead to stalk careless students and idle Magisters. His sole obsession is the mana that others possess...

See to it that he never harms another elf again.
91119.title: Prey: Lost Theldrin (Normal)

91120.description:
Poor Neydra... I knew her, in a previous life. She was full of vitality. Full of ambition. Unfortunately, she let that ambition get the best of her. She grew too enamored with the raw power of the arcane. She became resentful of all other things. Of all other people...

And now she is a murderous creature who beheads rats and attacks innocents in a desperate attempt to garner enough arcane energy to slake her unquenchable thirst.

It's funny, the paths life takes us...
91120.title: Prey: Neydra the Starving (Normal)

91121.description:
This one presents a prickly problem indeed. Thornspeaker Edgath has made a name for himself by using his druidic powers not to preserve Azeroth, but to twist its strength both against his enemies and innocent bystanders alike. He has no regard for anything that is not a beast or growing in the ground.

It is time we clip this thorn.
91121.title: Prey: Thornspeaker Edgath (Normal)

91122.description:
Thorn-Witch Liset is a curse upon civilization and a blight upon the land itself. She twists the very trees and beasts, communing with the dark, evil things that live on the very edges of the natural realm.

I despise the natural realm.
91122.title: Prey: Thorn-Witch Liset (Normal)

91123.description:
The Twilight's Blade are an embarrassing band of mediocre cultists and uninspired conspirators. Grothoz is the brains of a particularly stupid cabal that has been active in a nearby region. 

As his stupidity prevents him from using his whole brain, let us unlock his potential for him...
91123.title: Prey: Grothoz, the Burning Shadow (Normal)

91124.description:
Do you know why the Twilight's Blade call Dengzag the "Darkened Blaze?" It is because they are stupid, small-minded, and utterly bereft of imagination. What a silly name indeed. 

I, however, am not small-minded. I have quite the prodigious mind, and it is currently intent on putting an end to Dengzag and whatever his tiny brain is up to. 

Get to it.
91124.title: Prey: Dengzag, the Darkened Blaze (Normal)

91136.description:
Ja'kul was killed before he could finish my training, but I would recognize his work anywhere! He must have painted this vision stone for me!

The rutaani will catch on pretty soon that we're up here, and I won't be able to defend myself. Will you keep watch while I journey into the memory he left me?
91136.title: Memories in Stone

91137.description:
It seems some of our more adventurous guests have not returned from their hike. Val said he saw a rutaani skulking about earlier, but I was certain he was just trying to add some drama to our day.

The Lightbloom infiltrated the Sanctum to the north and has been spilling residual issues our way.

Our guests are here to escape the troubles of the world... This all could become a bit too real for them.

If you'll take care of that situation, I'll make sure Val keeps the guests distracted.
91137.title: Lost in Light

91138.description:
Such a small thing, really. And devoid of any of the power T'uure once nurtured. But a relic of inestimable value nonetheless.

Did you know, {class}, that to T'uure, the dark and the light were inseparable aspects of a greater truth?

What creates, has the power to destroy in equal measure. Demonstrate this lesson and you will reach a new understanding of yourself, and of the great Naaru whose sacrifice was able to halt the annihilation of an entire planet.
91138.title: I am the Creator and Destroyer

91140.description:
<This crystalline fragment has lost any luster it once had. Now finally extricated from Dimensius's dread form and in the hands of the devout, a brief glimmer revives in its depths.

Perhaps someone in Tazavesh will know more.>
91140.title: A Piece of the Past

91145.description:
A domanaar was harrying our back lines. It was... different than the other void beasts--like it was playing rather than fighting. My partner, Callum, led a squad to hunt it down. They never came back.

Callum's an Arathi through and through. He wouldn't fall here--I know it.

Commander Lightblood refused to send a search party. He said there's a difference between personal and important. Well, the Vanguard can have their war, but I'm going after Cal. I know the route he took, but I can't search alone.
91145.title: The Conquered Heroes

91146.description:
I feel traces of Light here--dim, scattered across the plain, but unmistakable. It's Callum. I know his Light like I know my own.

That domanaar is a monster: using others like toys, smashing them together until they break. We'll find them, {name}, and then I will turn that void beast to ash.

<Anais grips her spear.>

One thing at a time. Find the Light, and we find Callum.
91146.title: Flickering Light

91147.description:
Revik, Riandron, Danna... that domanaar made them kill each other. The creatures here are bound with the same shadowgrafts: the same twisted magic.

If this is how Imperia controls her victims, we have to find a way to remove it.

Restrain the beasts and I'll attempt to break their bonds. If it's forged by the Void, the Light must be able to overcome it.
91147.title: Cut Her Strings

91148.description:
When the Light called, it called both of us. Why? So Callum could die on some void-scarred rock?

I can't think here. All I can picture is Callum bleeding out. Come, we'll return to camp. With his belongings, I should be able to find him. 

Then... I don't know. If we can't break the shadowgrafts, we'll subdue him and drag him back to Silvermoon if we must. I'm not losing him.
91148.title: Strung Along

91149.description:
I knew we'd never grow old together, but I thought we'd have more time.

<Anais coughs, blood pooling beneath her. Flecks of the Void shimmer in the spreading crimson.>

Don't worry. I'm not afraid. I promised myself I wouldn't go home without him... wouldn't spend a night in an empty bed. I'm just keeping that promise.

Don't let her have him. Take his tinder box. You'll know what to do.
91149.title: Bury Me Not

91173.description:
These Sureki sure are a persistent bunch! We need to match their persistence with our blades.

Can we count on your continued support in the battles ahead?
91173.title: The Flame Burns Eternal

91206.description:
Now dat we are tryin' to contact all de loa, my mind turns to Kulzi, de loa of medicine--and the madness that surrounds his shrine.

His loa speaker, Sij'ta, was a good friend. He healed many war parties of their injuries. But somethin' happened at Kulzi's shrine, and it is full of angry spirits.

Dey attack anybody dat tries to get through to dem, and de loa is silent.

Perhaps you can finally reach out to de loa and find his speaker!
91206.title: Loa Disturbance

91210.description:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.
91210.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Hard)
