You handled yourself well.

These documents are too important to pass through couriers or ravens. I'd like you to deliver them personally to Lor'themar. He'll want to see the truth for himself and know who brought it back.

Keep them close, and don't let anyone else near them.
91827.title: No Loose Ends

91828.description:
A letter arrived for me. No seal, no name. Just folded parchment and handwriting I'd recognize anywhere.

It didn't say much. He never wastes words. 

I've known his family a long time. When they reach out, I answer.
91828.title: A Favor for the Lion

91829.description:
Every last cultist is a threat to the people we're trying to save. To Silvermoon itself.

Blasted fanatics with blood on their hands and no intention of letting anyone walk out alive.

We're already in the camp. Let's make it count. I want them to feel this.
91829.title: One by One

91830.description:
The Twilight's Blade hit Tranquillien hard. Slipped in and took all the supplies and information they could ever need, right beneath everyone's nose.

Time to return the favor.

I've marked a few tents. Command posts, messengers' satchels, a supply ledger tucked under a wine crate. That's where they keep their orders, maps, and routes.

Grab everything you can.
91830.title: Intercepted

91831.description:
These people joined the Twilight's Blade looking for purpose, power, or place to belong. For a reprieve from the fear and a promise of certainty.

Now they see it for what it is--a prison dressed up as faith. And they want out.

We go in together. Get them out before the cult realizes what's happening.
91831.title: Keys Are Optional

91833.description:
De Vilebranch are sinkin' deeper into their cursed minds. Dey spit in de face of de loa, and believe dey have mastered death.

I could see a certain... someone not likin' dat way of thinkin'.

Dey have taken our kin and now dey take our shaman. Meet my scout there and help dem break their plans.

Cut de head off de beast and de body will fall.
91833.title: Dirty Deeps

91834.description: Get rid of shield face and meet me in de hut below.
91834.title: Guardians Must Go

91835.description:
My friend, dis is a mighty gift. Shadra is givin' us a blessin' for de tasks ahead.

These Vilebranch really are livin' up to their name. Dey drain de spirit from de Witherbark and create undead to serve dem.

We must free de Witherbark from these necrotic bonds.

My friend's still in there... I hope. Me and Bin'zin cut our tusks together growin' up. He grew into a strong shaman. Our village needs him, and he is like a brother to me.
91835.title: Send Dem Home

91836.description:
When dey took Bin'zin, de priestess destroyed his totems and gave de shattered remains to her minions--like some grisly memento.

Take de pieces back, one by one if ya have to. Dat disrespect will not stand.
91836.title: Respect de Totem

91837.description:
Big thanks for breakin' us free. Some were not so lucky.

Bring dey bones back to de Chief, he will know what to do.
91837.title: Bring Back De Bones

91838.description:
These vile orbs are harvestin' de souls of our people and sendin' dark energy to de Knife Priestess. She's gettin' mighty powerful.

Destroy de orbs so her ritual of death is ruined. With de gift of Shadra, ya will not fail.
91838.title: De Vile Diminished

91839.description:
Our shaman is home and Jin'zin's full of joy to see him again. She was always his little wildcat apprentice.

Dey will have sad moments--Tan'zin is a mighty loss.

Today, ya brought him home. Go enjoy dat for a bit, {name}, before ya be on ya way.
91839.title: Sacrifice Denied

91840.description:
Now's our best shot! We end de sacrifices here! Stoppin' de dark energy has weakened her hold.

Then, you can be de one to bring back her head.

Uh, and {name}--no tellin' de chief about me callin' him Big VunVun. He'll be turnin' me into a frog if he hears dat again.
91840.title: One Will Not Rise

91842.description:
The Dark Horde have no love fer their equipment. Look at their weapons! Cracked, rusted, blunt, and bent. Ach!

The only way they function is by making more shoddy tools to constantly replace the ones they've broken.

If ye see any of their weapon racks, destroy 'em. Let's see how well they fight without their rusty blades.

A bare-fisted orc is nothing to sneeze at, but it'll further delay any daft plans they've got.
91842.title: Disarm the Dark Horde

91843.description: To understand the story of The War Within, one must first begin with the mysterious entity known as the Harbinger, and how the heroes of Azeroth uncovered the truth...
91843.title: Recap: The Harbinger

91845.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Senior Executive Chronographer

91846.title: Infinite Research Promotion: Principal Chronoquery Investigator

91854.description:
Champion, I could use your assistance. The natives here in Silvermoon are proving to be less hospitable than we had hoped. 

In their defense, their city is facing down a darkness unlike anything Azeroth has ever faced, so tensions are high.

Can you use your unique perspective and help de-escalate some of the hot spots that are emerging around Silvermoon?
91854.title: Deepening Shadows

91855.description:
I know now that the heroes of Azeroth venture wherever help is needed. K'aresh is a strange, faraway place, but our allies there need us.

Go there and help them. See what you can do to bring respite to the ethereals and brokers.
91855.title: Worldsoul: K'aresh World Quests

91863.description:
Welcome to the neighborhood! Feel free to explore and have a look at the plots available.

Speak to the steward to learn more about the process of becoming a homeowner or if you wish to create your own neighborhood.
91863.title: My First Home

91864.description: All across Azeroth, many were having visions of a Radiant Song. Efforts to understand what seemed to be a warning centered on the heroes in Dalaran.
91864.title: Recap: Fractured Visions

91865.description: The Earthen of Khaz Algar eventually welcomed the outsiders into their land, but all was not well with them. Divisions had grown among their people. To unravel Xal'atath's plot with the Nerubians, the Champions would have to address these issues.
91865.title: Catch Up: Khaz Algar

91866.description: The Champions travel with Brinthe of the Earthen and Moira, Dagran and Magni Bronzebeard to the Ringing deeps. There they find not all is well as a mysterious affliction has touched some of the workers.
91866.title: Catch Up: The Ringing Deeps

91867.description: King Anduin Wrynn, Alleria and the Champions travel deeper into Azeroth, arriving at a place known as Hallowfall. It quickly become apparent that this place has also been touched by the machinations of Xal'atath.
91867.title: Catch Up: Hallowfall

91868.description: King Anduin Wrynn, Alleria, and the champions travel deeper into Azeroth, arriving at a place known as Hallowfall. It quickly becomes apparent that this place has also been touched by the machinations of Xal'atath.
91868.title: Recap: Shadowy Pursuits

91869.description: The War Within continued on Khaz Algar as the peoples of the land began to unite against Xal'atath and her Dark Heart.
91869.title: Catch Up: A Light in the Dark

91871.description: The champions and Alleria were invited to Undermine by Gazlowe as the peoples of Khaz Algar and beyond began to unite against Xal'atath and her Dark Heart.
91871.title: Recap: The Dark Heart

91872.description:
{name}, I was the Rootwarden of Teldrassil. For years, I watched the roots here below the surface, but I was not aware of what was threatening the tree outside of Harandar.

For just as long, I have regretted that failure, but we cannot change the past.

I wonder, however, if roots so great may still have life within them. Might there be something which can still be done?

I do not know, but I do hope. Will you join me at the Shrine of Ages, to tend the roots?
91872.title: The Former Rootwarden

91873.description:
At this shrine, I have worked to gather roots that seem to still have the possibility of life within them. They are each greatly damaged, some more than others. My hope is some might recover, with enough time and enough care. In that way, I honor the great tree's memory.

For that to be possible, though, we have to keep them safe from the hazards of Harandar.

Please be sure that nothing nearby threatens them.
91873.title: Buffer Zone

91874.description:
{name}, I see smoke rising above Har'mara. The roots are on fire--not here, but beneath the remnants of the tree!

I have seen this happen many times, but we must always respond with haste.

Take to the skies and douse them, immediately!
91874.title: Flare Up

91875.description:
If we ever hope to see new growth, Teldrassil's roots needs a great deal of special attention.

The source of this stream is one of the great roots. The water carries ash, which I believe still contains the tree's essence.

The stalkers in the stream carry a mixture of that ash and slime from their tendrils--a very potent mixture.

Bring me as much of it as you can carry, and I will combine it with reagents I've gathered. Then we'll be ready to apply it to the roots.
91875.title: Natural Remedy

91876.description:
Thank you for tending to those fires, {name}. While you were gone, I've used that sludge to make a salve. Help me spread it over Teldrassil's roots.

It may take years to see a difference, if we ever do. But though I failed, I made oaths to her, and I can still choose to keep them. I will never stop doing what I can to... help her perhaps grow again.

If I do not succeed, the next Rootwarden, or the one who comes after that, may be the one to finish this work. Even so, I shall not stop trying.
91876.title: Tending Hope

91884.description:
You! Have YOU seen them?

I've been tasked to investigate some of our scouts that have gone missing. My reconnaissance had come up empty until recently.

Now I've been catching glimpses of the missing scouts, but... they appear formed of pure Void energy.

Each time I chase the figures, they lead me further and further before disappearing!

The others think I'm crazy. You haven't seen anything like that, have you?
91884.title: The Illusion of Motion

91885.description:
Do you... see...? They follow... They plead... for help...

<The voidwalker strains and shudders as it tries to communicate.>

Too weak... too starving...

<It feebly hands you a shard of dark matter.>

This... will feed me... then together... we find the missing elves...
91885.title: Drain You

91886.description:
The voices of your elven allies rattle inside my head.

I know of a way we can find them. There is a way to locate missing things... using old domanaar scanning devices.

But they require immense energy to function. Together, we can use these devices to focus the images of your lost friends. Their cries for help will become clearer, and then you can find them.

Come. Lend me your strength.
91886.title: Voices of Omens

91887.description:
We were right to be cautious. The threats we've found here in the Voidstorm are corrupting and irredeemable.

This voidwalker's meticulous deceptions are unusual... I can't help but wonder why it would go through all the trouble. 

<She looks up at you from weary, withered eyes.>

But I'm too weak to go on. It really did a number on me. You have the upper hand now! It thinks you're walking into its trap.

Walk in with weapons drawn and spells ready!
91887.title: Dominion of Deceit

91918.description:
We've done well to see those deserters to safety, but don't fool yourself into thinking we've freed them all.

I've heard whispers of a place they use to break those whose loyalty is in question. The location isn't common knowledge, but I know where to start looking.

If we're quick, we might find others before the cult decides they're too great a risk to keep alive.

Meet me near the site. Keep your blades sharp and your steps light.
91918.title: Delves: Measure Once, Cut Twice

91928.description:
My Shadowtrade Mercenaries will fight for Stormarion Cores, no questions asked, but they do get hungry also!

Food is quite scarce here, so we need supplies!

Take a mercenary out with you and find some food for them to eat. I'll make it worth your while!
91928.title: What's For Lunch?

91929.description:
My Shadowtrade Mercenaries will fight for Stormarion Cores, no questions asked, but they do get hungry also!

Food is quite scarce here, so we need supplies!

Take a mercenary out with you and find some food for them to eat. I'll make it worth your while!
91929.title: What's For Lunch?

91930.description:
De loa have reunited with us forest trolls, and de land reacts with glorious bounty!

Do ya wish to take part? Then go north, and meet me at de entrance to Loaknit Den.

There I will introduce ya to prosperity and plentitude like ya never seen...
91930.title: The Abundant Lands

91932.description:
De Loa of Abundance accepts everyone, and everyone de Loa of Abundance accepts is granted de privilege of learnin' how best to serve abundance.

Speak with his glorious visage and become a fellow acolyte.
91932.title: The Abundant Awakening

91933.description:
On to the next phase of your education: mercantilism!

Imagine yourself, offering the bounty of endless harvest to my glorious self, and reaping the abundant rewards I bestow upon you in kind.

Now let us put that beauteous vision into practice! 

I will grant you a minute portion of unalloyed abundance. You, in turn, shall trade it to your fellow acolyte for one of many premium goods.
91933.title: The Abundant Honor

91955.description:
The artifact we snatched from the timeline earlier was replaced with a simulacrum so none would notice the true artifact's absence.

Such a wealth of infinite energy should not be abandoned so readily. You should seek it out and reclaim it.

Once you have recovered the simulacrum you can scrap it for an embarassing sum of bronze and infinite power.
91955.title: Just Between Us

91958.description:
Nalorakk is de Loa of War. His trial must be a battle!

There would be no greater death for an Amani than to die in combat against de Loa of War. No greater thrill than fightin' him.

Does it not make your blood pump faster and harder in your veins, hash'ura?

<Zul'jarra lets out a feral howl and laughs.>

Come. Meet me at Nalorakk's Prowl and we will sit at his fire and face our last trial--together.
91958.title: Den of Nalorakk: Unforgiven

91963.description:
I've heard from the other scouts about that metal--the shadowgraft. The domanaar use it to enforce their control over others.

I have to imagine that there's someone holding the reins still. Maybe it's Xal'atath, or maybe someone else. Gather pieces of their shadowgraft and maybe we can make sense of who.
91963.title: Running Amok

91967.description:
Champion, we have a bit of a delicate situation.
 
The Vanguard of the Light has just informed me they have taken Magister Umbric into custody. Apparently he was trying to get close to the Sunwell.

I do not have to tell you that tensions are high between my city and the Vanguard. We need Umbric to continue his research if we are to have a chance at contending with the Voidstorm.

I want you to represent me in negotiating Umbric's release. Whether we like him or not, we need him.
91967.title: You Know This Evil?

91968.description:
What a mess! Perhaps the previous owners left in a hurry. Best tidy up!

The items removed will be sent to the house chest. They can always be placed down again, if cobwebs are your thing.
91968.title: Welcome Home

91969.description:
Now that we've got this place tidied up, let's decorate!

The community has chipped in with donations to make sure you have plenty of options to work with.

Let's have a look!
91969.title: Time to Decorate

91970.description:
Are you ready to test yourself against a true foe? In the center of the Gloom Mire is Gelatonius, a fungal giant of enormous proportions. 

Kill him, if you think you can. I'm willing to be impressed, and to pay handsomely for this task.
91970.title: WANTED: Gelatonius

91971.description:
The Twilight Hammer is dirtying up the ruins of Zeb'tala. Clean up the area and bring back some of their personal tokens. One never knows what curiosities may appeal to those vying for relevancy.

Those mindless cultists may stomp around and act tough, but you will make quick work of them.
91971.title: Hitting the Hammer

91972.description:
There is still a lot of friction on the border with Zul'Aman, but we must hold the watch on all fronts.

Check in with Bloodguard Nelric at the Thalassian Pass. It is rumored to be one of the most uneventful posts. I am certain he would appreciate a reprieve, if only for a few moments.

Stay alert, {name}!
91972.title: Hold the Watch

91973.description:
It seems the locals currently find great appeal in naga blades--the brinier the better. On our southwestern shore, you will find the Daggerspine naga.

They have these grungy, barnacle-encrusted scimitars that would perfectly fit the bill.

Go grab a few of those. They could have value in some of our upcoming discussions.
91973.title: Naga Blades

91974.description:
I guess there is one benefit to being part of the courtly intrigue: one does hear things. We have this concoction of sunfire infused with the holy energy of the Blood Knights, courtesy of the court alchemists.

Take this down to the Sanctum of the Moon and test it on the Twilight intruders. I look forward to hearing the results in detail.
91974.title: Sunfire to the Blade

91975.description:
It seems the lure of the lightwood continues to be a problem.

We may as well take advantage of the trolls' hard work! Collect what they have harvested. We can make use of it.

What we do not use for weapons, we can hand over to the carvers. The nobles will clamor over lightwood decor.
91975.title: That's Our Wood

91976.description:
All of this small talk makes my ears twitch. I would be so much more useful doing field work. For now, you get to do the fun part.

The creatures within the Lightbloom are getting a bit dense. I need you to get out there and lower the volume.

I am sure you'll run into many options while you are out there. Take a whack at a few for me.
91976.title: Lightbloom Dimmed

91977.description:
The Tideborne are always running just over the legal line. They are an annoyance at best, but will push boundaries when given too much rope.

The ones in Sunsail Anchorage made the mistake of ripping off some nobles not too long ago. Maybe go smack them around a bit--remind them to respect their betters.
91977.title: Less Lawless

91978.description:
Have you ever noticed, that sometimes there is benefit in letting someone think they are getting away with something? The Tideborne will continue to smuggle in plain sight, feeling clever at the taxes they're avoiding paying to Silvermoon.

This does add up, though, over time. When you have a moment, please head down to the harbor and relieve them of some of their back taxes.
91978.title: Taxing the Tideborne

91979.description:
We received word there's a creature from Lightbloom Ath'Ran making trouble on the western coast. It has caused a bit of drama.

Head over and resolve the issue.
91979.title: Chop It Down

91980.description:
See that huge creature over that way? That's Hellebora. She's set herself up too close to the road and we're concerned she's going to wander out of the mire and become even more of a threat. 

Deal with her, if you can, and bring me back one of her thorns as proof of your hunt.
91980.title: WANTED: Hellebora's Thorn

91982.description:
The three-headed hydra, Hellabora, has been causing havoc in the lower end of Gloom Mire.

Give her a good pruning and bring me back her petals as proof.
91982.title: WANTED: Toadshade's Petals

91983.description:
The beautiful members of the Silvermoon Court do so love their colorful embellishments.

For this, we can stock up while doing a good deed! Head over to Thuron's Livery and pick up some of the brightly colored feathers shed from the hawkstriders in training.

Vaelith gets clean up service and we get the lovely plumage.
91983.title: Lovely Plumage

91984.description:
Oh, {name}, have you ever visited the Solaarian Sunbath? If not, it's highly recommended.

The sungrubs that wander nearby have a precious silk from which amazing fabric can be made. Solwin Brightstitch is reputed to be masterful in this, with his sartorial magic.

The raw materials are often sought out to have him create unique and personalized goods from scratch. Bring us some of that lovely silk. It will provide a soft cushion when faced with harder discussions.
91984.title: Sungrub Silk

91985.description:
The nobles do so love the unusual. Take a look around Windrunner Village. There are sure to be some interesting mementos still tucked away there.

I will find an advantageous home for the pieces you bring back.
91985.title: Windrunner Memorabilia

91986.description:
Those naga are, as ever, being a beachfront nuisance. Do they not understand that is a prime location?

We may not be able to reliably drive them off, but a little mischief would not be untoward.

I found this tune that drives the snapdragons mad. They will just attack whoever is nearby. Take this and give it a shot!
91986.title: Put a Little Snap in Their Step

91987.description:
It seems some of the nobles are botany-curious where the Lightbloom is concerned. They seek the exotic to adorn their windowsills and lurk in the dangerous section of their greenhouses.

That's where you come in, {name}!

Go harvest those small and pernicious plants. Their bulbs will be the best for planting.
91987.title: Potted Lashers

91988.description:
The conservators at Brightwing Estate have a mischievous young dragonhawk named Cerul that likes to run away whenever their backs are turned. He doesn't go far, but it has become a game for him to get them to chase him.

Take this delicious treat with you and use it to lure him back home.
91988.title: Brightwing Conservation

91989.description:
The delicate blue ghostland peppers may not look like much, but they have a mean burn. Many nobles won't admit it, but they are quite popular in the noble games of "Truth or Challenge."

Please procure a few for me. I like to watch them sweat.
91989.title: Ghostland Peppers

91990.description:
Naga have set up camp on the Sunset Strand. The sunset slugs that called it home are distraught and seem unsure what to do. This little tune will remind them of their home.

Go inspire them to seek the freedom of the open sea.
91990.title: Sunset to Sea

91991.description:
When conversations get tense, it can be challenging to keep words flowing in a productive way. At times like these, I find a little social lubrication is in order.

Swing over to Goldenmist Village and pick up a cask of Vintner's Golden. It's proven to have a euphoric side effect that can be quite helpful.
91991.title: A Little Errand

91992.description:
I entrusted one of my apprentices with the delivery of several cases of particularly expensive wine. He was to bring them here from my private storage, but he has not yet arrived.

I should hate to ask you to retrieve him, but I cannot stress enough how expensive those bottles are.

Please see if you can locate him and my delivery. He should have been traveling from the north to arrive here.
91992.title: Where Has the Wine Gone?

91993.description:
Keeping preciously small animals as pets is a popular pastime among the nobility. The more unconventional the animal, often obtained through magic, the more of a conversation piece it is.

I have enchanted this wand with the appropriate shrinking spell. Use it on some of the colorful toads out near the ponds and bring them back here. The nobles will find them delightful.

Naturally, the toads may not take kindly to the enchantment. But I trust you can handle that, should it occur.
91993.title: Diminutive Demand

91994.description:
Lord Saltheril, that old lynx, has put me in a bit of a bind.

He has requested a grand fireworks display to accompany tonight's dinner service, but we are dreadfully low on pyrepetal dust. It is an herb native to Eversong, highly flammable and quite dazzling when set aflame by pyromancy.

Could you help us replenish our stores? We mostly harvest it from the woods near Scintilas Falls.
91994.title: Pyrepetal Purposes

91995.description:
Have you seen the encampments the naga have been constructing along our coast? Dreadful business.

Not only do they menace our ships and disrupt our trade routes, but they might pose a real threat to Eversong's inland settlements if allowed to continue operations unchecked.

Their arcanists are particularly dangerous. Dispose of them and our guests will be in your debt.
91995.title: What Horrible Magic

91996.description:
Battle prowess and magical skill are important, of course, but one cannot deny the power of appearances. A well-dressed army instills far more faith than one bedecked in rags.

Fortunately, a fine set of robes can be both flattering and functional. The mana silk produced at the North Sanctum can be woven into robes that deepen and intensify our magical reserves.

Be a dear and gather some for us, would you? My wardrobe could use a seasonal refreshment.
91996.title: Fit for a Magister

91997.description:
The festivities have been wonderfully entertaining, which means the nobles have been leaving a bit of a mess around the estate. Lord Saltheril's servants have been keeping up with the cleaning, but the Magisters could lend a hand.

Enchanting a few brooms to sweep the pavilion should be an easy but impressive feat.

I was informed that an arcanist was employing the same tactic over at Farstrider Hold. Go retrieve some of his brooms and I will have them re-enchanted here.
91997.title: Power Clean

91998.description:
Deep within the swamp is a creature of mud, leaves, and rage. His vines choke the life out of any who come near, and this dangerous creature cannot be allowed to live.

Defeat Muckmire and bring me back his vines as proof of the deed.
91998.title: WANTED: Muckmire's Choking Vines

91999.description:
You know, I bring Saltheril a lot of "imported" wine, but one of the first things I started supplying him with was bloodthistle. It's an herb that only grows around Eversong. It's got a smooth bite to it, sort of like mana. Nice and classy. His parties really go through the stuff.

I took a look and I don't think he has enough to last this whole thing. We should get some more.

The best stuff grows over by the West Sanctum. Grab as much as you can carry. Trust me--it'll go fast.
91999.title: A Bit of Bloodthistle

92000.description:
This place is pretty fun so far, despite all the dry political talk. I know Saltheril is trying to get the nobles to buy up war bonds, but we could really use some more energy in here. If the nobles are all asleep, no one's buying anything.

Tell you what. Go invite some of my friends. They hang out under the bridge right outside of Silvermoon's gates.

If anyone can bring some energy to the soiree, it's us.
92000.title: Bring the Ruckus

92001.description:
The whole point of this deal is showing the nobles what we bring to the table, both for Silvermoon and for them personally.

These other groups bring strength, power, and really nice armor. What we bring is resources: getting the sin'dorei what they need, when they need it, with no questions asked.

I heard some folks over at Sunsail Anchorage have been trying out the same business, but they're putting gold in the wrong pockets. Swipe their stock and bring it here.
92001.title: One Smuggler to Another

92002.description:
You'd be surprised at the money you can make off of weapons. No, not the kind you're meant to use--the kind you stick up on the wall and have conversations about.

Usually those weapons are expensive, or dangerous, or otherwise hard to get your hands on. The more rare and exclusive, the better.

The weapons those Twilight cultists are carrying around should sell pretty well, especially to buyers with edgier tastes. If you happen to come across any, I'll gladly take them off your hands.
92002.title: Dangerous Showpieces

92003.description:
Don't let the austere demeanor fool you. Nobles are just as susceptible to flashy party favors as the rest of us.

I had my people bring over a batch of Felo'melorn replicas. They look great on display, and even better--they're enchanted. Swing them around and they leave a trail of fire.

I haven't sold an enchanted batch before, so I'd like to do some testing before I hand them out. Saltheril wouldn't be too happy if I burned a guest to a crisp.

Wanna take one of the replicas for a test run?
92003.title: Artisanal Replicas

92004.description:
I feel like I just got here and I'm already fresh out of half the poisons I brought.

What? Don't look at me like that. Nobles are some of my top customers for poisons. Quieter than magic and cleaner than blades.

I need to restock. The frogs way down in the south produce a poisonous slime that I can bottle without much fuss. Bring some of it to me and I'll get you a cut of the earnings.
92004.title: Shady Dealings

92005.description:
We've been making friends with some of the guests by teaching them how to play dice. It's a nice way to draw people out of the crowd and get them in a quieter space where you can talk privately.

I wasn't expecting so much interest, to be honest. We're running out of dice sets.

I can carve some more, but I'll need materials. Usually teeth or bone are good picks. Actually, the fangs from those naga along the coast would be perfect. Now that's a conversation starter!
92005.title: Throw the Dice

92006.description:
I talked to some of the servants earlier and it sounds like the casks are running low. That's a recipe for disaster at an event like this.

Fortunately, I've got a lot of contacts across Eversong who can help us restock.

I need to stay here and play politics, but could you head over to Tranquillien and grab a few bottles? I'll give you a list.
92006.title: We Need a Refill

92007.description:
The oldest trick in the book is to create a problem on purpose, solve it yourself, and look like the hero.

One of the nobles just got word that some prized valuable was stolen from their estate while they were occupied here. It just so happens I might have put one of their servants up to it.

Go talk to a man named Seridis over at the livery. He'll hand over the valuable to you, then you'll come back here and pretend you valiantly subdued the thief and retrieved the item.

Everyone's happy.
92007.title: Begged, Borrowed, or Stolen

92010.description:
Not far from here, Slewstalk lurks in the shallows. This creature has developed a taste for flesh and bones, and it won't be long until she wanders out of the Mire in search for warmer blooded prey.

Take her out and bring me her luminescent stalks. They'll serve as proof and also make a fine centerpiece for an evening table.
92010.title: WANTED: Slewstalk's Stalks

92012.description:
Gorebarb is a creature quite unlike most others who make Harandar their home. He's incredibly violent and his kind is not seen here very often. 

Let's see less of him. Kill him and bring me his pincers as proof of the deed.
92012.title: WANTED: Gorebarb's Pincers

92013.description:
Many thornmaws make the mire their home, but none as are vicious as Dionaea. Unlike the others, she kills merely for the joy of it, and her gluttony threatens the delicate balance of the wildlife in this area. 

Take her out and restore the equilibrium. Bring me back her thorntusks as proof of the deed.
92013.title: WANTED: Dionaea's Thorntusks

92021.description:
My colleague Amalthea has taken ill. She requires a specialized poultice of sorts in order to ease the symptoms. I would forage for the plants myself, but the local fauna have grown so testy as of late!

While you are out and about, could you gather some graveblossoms for me? I'd happily make it worth your while.
92021.title: Graveblossom Gardening

92022.description:
My poultice requires venom samples from the local giant bat populations. Please retrieve some of those, as well. Six common vials' worth should do.

Don't give me that look. They're bats. There are mad Light-plant-things to the east and a storm of voidwalkers swirling over our heads. Don't you dare give me guff about the dangers of big, fluffy bats. Now shoo. My colleague is depending on your prompt and efficient aid.
92022.title: A Venomous Vocation

92023.description:
Forgive me for my failure to provide specifics, traveler. The mournbat venom and the graveblossoms were only the first of the reagents I require for my associate's medication.

Luckily, the final few things I require can all be easily obtained in Goldenmist Village to the north. Be a dear and fetch these last few things for me, won't you? With these, my toil will be nearly complete.
92023.title: Suspicious Sundries

92024.description:
That woman, that "apothecary," has snared you in one of her schemes.

I'd be careful around her, {class}. Rumors travel like wildfire in Eversong. And while I would never disparage a fellow artisan of Eversong without cause, I have heard enough rumors to know that your apothecary deals in more than simple herbs.

Take your wine and your reagents, I suppose. But before you pass them off to your patroness, I'd recommend doing some digging--lest you find yourself wrapped up in something you come to regret.
92024.title: House Call

92025.description:
<The final pages of the tome detail a meeting place. Whatever Talandra Dawnsprite intends to do, she means to do it amidst the ghosts of Windrunner Spire.

The time for Talandra's ritual grows nigh.>
92025.title: Flowers for Amalthea

92028.description:
{name}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly interrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
92028.title: Pardon the Interruption

92030.description:
Chon was just looking for you. You can find him at his house, serving drinks with Chen.

<Lorewalker Cho laughs--a deep, warm rumble.>

Go on, {name}! I won't be leaving anytime soon, that's for sure.
92030.title: A New Tradition

92031.description: <The Manaforge Vandals at Shadow Point are eager to see the Shadowguard and their allies removed from Manaforge Omega. It's probably a good time to pay them a visit.>
92031.title: Meet the Vandals

92061.description:
That was an entropic wave. We felt them just before Xal'atath launched her assault on the Sunwell. 

Champion, you move faster than my best messengers. I need you to check in with the Vanguard commanders and see if their defenses will hold against this latest assault by Xal'atath's Devouring Host.
92061.title: Rising Storm

92084.description:
Who are these people? Where did they come from?

Did dey find their way here from Numazon? How? De mist keeps you from knowin' if you are comin' or goin'.

And where is Halazzi?

I need answers... now!
92084.title: Halazzi's Guile

92104.description:
Hmm. You look like you can ride a broom without crashin' into a chimney.

Hallow's End is a busy time for all kinds of deliveries. Got sweets, potions, pumpkins, haunted socks - don't ask - all goin' to the usual oddballs.

Take that broom over there, fly fast to make those deliveries, and don't drop nothin'.
92104.title: Broomstick Express

92106.description:
Midsummer is the time to reflect and a time to tell stories by the bonfire.

One such story is the tale of the sun blossom ritual and how this offering to An'she first came to be.

Our journey will take us through Northern Kalimdor, into territories beyond the lands of the shu'halo.

If you wish, take to the skies of Kalimdor and ignite the blossoms as I tell the tale.

Our story begins in the Western Barrens...
92106.title: Ignite the Skies: Northern Kalimdor

92136.description:
I hope my staff's light has been enough to uphold those at the Sunwell while we have sought these relics.

Together with those from Light's Hope, they should be a much more significant aid.

Let us return there quickly.
92136.title: Infusion of Hope

92155.description:
I reached out to examine a console that had dark energy moving through it, but something screamed in my face. It was so unexpected.

It didn't feel like an alarm, more like something... vicious. Angry. Hungry. It almost felt like it wanted to grab me.

Terrifying. And interesting!

Take a look around and see what you can learn. Check for visible disturbances.
92155.title: Object Exorcism

92156.description:
You must listen. An evil creature attached itself to me not long ago. It followed me about, angrily hurling objects, playing tricks, and consuming anything it could.

Just now, it stopped following me. It likes you now, I think.

If you feed it, it should leave you be for a time. Mark the defeated in the Sparring Grounds with this brand. It should consume them, giving us time to talk more.
92156.title: It Follows Me

92157.description:
While you were gone, we were busy.

My idea is to force the malevolent entity out into the open--out of its hiding places. Havazza gathered up items that have the entity attached to them. I don't trust her, but if she wants to lift heavy things, at least I don't have to.

By destroying the scattered things it is possessing, we will flush it out of hiding!
92157.title: Ritual Activity

92158.description:
The entity is definitely attached to you, {name}. It even imitated you. I bet it mimics the body of its main target, changing depending on what it's eating. Now that I've seen it in action, I'm confident I can make a container to hold it.

You trust me, right?

Just outside of Shadow Rise, there is a clear area on the upper bluffs of Claw's Edge. I want to get it away from these objects, like that chair.

Brand yourself as defeated and wait. It will come. Ambush it when you see an opening. We'll trap it!
92158.title: Let It In

92159.description:
Havazza betrayed us and left you to clean up after her. It could have killed you. She should face the consequences of her actions.

I am sure she is back to duels, revelling in her returned strength at your expense. We should start with the Shenzar Refinery area next to the Sparring Grounds.

Challenge her to a real duel!
92159.title: A Final Destination

92163.description:
Have you heard of de commotion comin' from Atal'Abasi? De murlocs there are gettin' riled up about somethin'.

It seems like de murlocs have summoned a loa of their own. And dis loa is rallyin' de murlocs to war.

I saw it myself! Just today, lookin' down from dis cliff. De biggest murloc you've ever seen!

I'm not de only one who've seen it either! But de elders say we have bigger problems. Bah!

Dey better not come to me when we get overrun by murlocs!
92163.title: The Loa of Murlocs

92164.description:
These murlocs have come to me, the Loa of Murlocs, to seek my protection against an evil invader.

The Deepfin have risen from the abyssal depths of the ocean. They have invaded this land and defiled its grounds!

I charge you, champion, to defend this kingdom and drive the Deepfin back into the sea!

<King Mrgl-Mrgl lowers his voice to a whisper.>

Get rid of the invaders and maybe the natives won't need me to protect them, and I can leave!
92164.title: Murloc Madness

92165.description:
I have heard your mrgls, my people. Your stomachs grgl in hunger!

The invaders have cut you off from the food you so desperately need to survive.

I will send my champion to gather fish so you may fill your bellies once more!

<King Mrgl-Mrgl lowers his voice to a whisper.>

Or you can just give me fish if you have some?
92165.title: Fish Are Food, Not Friends

92166.description:
My fellow murlocs! One among you was chosen to be my... my chosen!

She is destined for greatness and is my assistant... erm, priestess! Yes, priestess of the loa!

Your priestess has gone missing, possibly taken by the treacherous Deepfin.

To showcase my great power, I will send my champion to find and return her to you.

<King Mrgl-Mrgl lowers his voice to a whisper.>

My assistant is missing, and I'm stuck here! Find her and tell her I'm on top of the temple!
92166.title: Following Suit

92167.description:
I've observed the Deepfin kidnapping native murlocs and raising troll corpses as undead thralls. But they don't push further inland--they take them all back to the sea.

I think they're being led by a powerful murloc who remains safely offshore, hiding from view as it accepts its minions' tribute.

We can draw it out. If you put on this murloc suit and offer tribute, it might fool the leader into showing itself.

If we eliminate the leader, we might be able to save the native murlocs!
92167.title: There Can Be Only One

92177.description:
Again, we sin'dorei find our city under assault. And again, it is up to the finer minds among us to come to Silvermoon's aid.

Mortal anguish, it seems, is a powerful reflection of the soul. When contained and manipulated, anguish acts as a form of magic that we can wield to protect this great city.

I've located a number of anguish-filled targets across Azeroth.

Select and hunt one such target, storing their anguish in this crystalline vessel. Then return to me.
92177.title: One Hero's Prey

92178.description:
While you've been out pursuing targets, I've been developing various applications for anguish.

The power these raw emotions contain is unfathomable. For now, our applications might seem quaint, but given enough time, I'm certain my discoveries will further Silvermoon's aims.

Let me show you. Take the crystalline vessel and meet me below.
92178.title: Practical Magic

92179.description:
So far, anguish has been invaluable in bolstering our forces. Our weaponry and golems are all the more hardy and potent thanks to this newfound power.

I've also been developing ways to shape anguish into robust enchantments that can strengthen us elves.

Meet me downstairs. I will show you what I've found.
92179.title: Dark Mending

92180.description:
{name}...

While you've been away, I've been refining our work.

<He produces a jeweled ring in the palm of his hand.>

Small trinkets and jewelry that contain crystallized anguish.

I've discretely gifted these to a few willing Silvermoon citizens. I wish to observe the effect of a controlled concentration of anguish over time.

I've shaped the magic to lend the bearer health and strength. Seek our volunteers out and check up on them.
92180.title: Precious Jewels

92181.description:
{name}... I need you to attend to a matter in the city.

I've received word from Knight Captain Solara that there's been an incident in the Gardens of Remembrance. She reports elves have begun acting out violently, causing coalesced anguish to manifest and terrorize the residents.

You can use the crystalline vessel to reclaim the coalesced anguish and soothe the elves whose minds have crumbled.

So much of the magic will weigh heavy upon you, but I'm confident you have the strength.
92181.title: Garden Variety Sacrifices

92182.description:
I heard word of your heroics in the garden. Silvermoon thanks you for quelling the chaos.

And I thank you for recovering so much anguish.

The crystalline vessel may be the conduit, but the body must be robust to handle so much power... Like me, you have the strength to withstand the torrent of anguish inside you, at least for a short while.

Come, let me relieve you of the burden.
92182.title: The Sheep or the Wolf

92185.description:
Midsummer is the time to reflect on the past and share stories by the fireside.

One such tale is the defeat of Frost Lord Ahune!

But this is a story you must witness for yourself so you may share it around the bonfire with others!
92185.title: The Tale of the Frost Lord

92319.description:
Kurdran and I spent twenty years in Outland on the other side of the Dark Portal, after we'd pushed the Horde back with Khadgar, Turalyon, and Alleria.

There were some good times, but any day I don't wake up in Honor Hold is already a good day.

That whole time, Kurdran led our scouts with his gryphon, Sky'ree. And on his way out of Honor Hold, he would fly low and fast, dodging everything the orcs threw at him. I think it'd be hilarious if you could go find him some mementos!
92319.title: A Favor to Axe

92320.description:
In our reminiscing of past events, we were reminded of an artifact that we did not recover during our war with the Burning Legion.

This item is a vessel of great evil, and should not stay in the clutches of the remaining demonic forces.

To reach this item, we must journey to the Broken Shore where Tehd has a portal he has repurposed for our use. Will you join us on this hunt?
92320.title: Still Behind Enemy Portals

92321.description:
Tarenar and I heard stories about the invasion of Icecrown Citadel from all the way out in the Plaguelands.

But he's got it all wrong!

The elf thinks there were more Ebon Blade commanders than Argent Crusade in the Ashen Verdict. He's completely daft. Obviously there were more paladins!

Would you go poke around Icecrown Citadel and find me some proof? I'm sick of arguing with him!
92321.title: A Frostbitten Tally

92322.description:
Hello, {name}. Do you have a moment?

There's something important I lost during the assault on the Isle of Thunder: a pocket watch gifted to me by my old friend, Archmage Timear. Yes, that Timear... the one that can foresee the future. He told me this day would come and that you would assist me.

The watch was taken by the Council of Elders, specifically by High Priestess Mar'li. If you would go to the island and retrieve it from the Throne of Thunder, and we both know you will, I can get you there.
92322.title: Timear Foresees a Proof of Demise!

92323.description:
Hard to believe, isn't it? Horde and Alliance, same room, no stabbing.

I was reminiscing about my days in the Firelands, gathering luciferns. They had such a distinctive smell... somewhere between smoke and something long dead. It's been a while, and I almost miss it.

Grab a few for Zen'tabra and me, will you? She deserves the full experience.
92323.title: Where the Fire Once Burned

92324.description:
We are lucky the Uncrowned survived, and its archives, thanks to Taoshi. We've been reading them...

Have you heard of the great highborne city Dire Maul? The Uncrowned kept tabs on the dangerous prince, Tortheldrin, but since he died, the case was shelved.

These notes say there might be objects of interest in the city ruins, with a notable mention of Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying. That book was retrieved some time ago, but few know that several chapters were missing.

Let's reopen the case.
92324.title: Uncrowned's Cold Case

92325.description:
My sister Krenna was once a Conqueror in the Horde's armies. Ruthless. Brutal. Some said a tyrant. But she was different when we were young. Scared, but always kind to me. Warm to those she would let in. Did power change her? 

And if it changed her into a tyrant, did it change Garrosh Hellscream as well? I know who Krenna was. I do not know who Garrosh was. 

Travel to Nagrand and find out.
92325.title: Hellscream's Heritage

92326.description:
I miss the smell of the desert. It is the fragrance of freedom in a wild land. I would love to refresh that scent memory.

While you're there, grab something from the caravans. This place could use some nomad personality.

Maybe hop over to Shatterstone Harbor and get something for the big guy. Maybe an anchor? That would be perfect! Imagine watching him lug that around.
92326.title: The Fragrance of the Dunes

92327.description:
It's always good to see someone with your history continue to speak to us old dogs, {name}.

Eitrigg and I have been talking about legacy recently. Did you know we both fought with the Valarjar against the Legion? Interesting how long histories can intertwine.

But our real legacy is our children. I wonder if you would have time to check in with them both. While you're there, make sure they're keeping their skills sharp.
92327.title: A Generational Moment

92331.description:
<The Trust is under pressure from the cartels to keep markets open. We seek associates capable of removing certain... obstacles. Cartel So has been authorized to distribute substantial riches if you are successful.

Complete the task, and collect a special reward from Fixer So'kir outside of the Dornogal Treasury. Parties shall remain unbound by any implied oaths arising in the course of trade. Uniform Broker Code standard terms apply.>
92331.title: Turbo-Boost: Trade Must Flow

92365.description:
Deploying defenses is crucial to safeguarding operation of the Singularity Anchor. I need to ensure you fully understand the process.

First, collect the Stormarion cores I have in storage. Then, activate the defensive positions, and finally, choose and deploy one defense at each position.

When you have completed that I can entrust you with further Stormarion Cores to use as you see fit.
92365.title: Creating Defenses

92390.description:
There is some peculiar activity in Shadow Rise to the northeast. Supposedly it is cursed! The Shadowguard usually have a heavy presence there, but I have word that they are abandoning the site.

I want to find out the truth of why they'd leave. Would you accompany me?
92390.title: Risk for Research

92396.description:
The wards on the runestones weaken by the hour. Without fresh arcane-charged crystals, the Lightbloom will gain ground.

I know this is not your burden to bear as you have much more to handle, but if you could see these supplies delivered, it would mean more than I can say.

Will you lend your strength to this task, for the sake of all who call this place home?
92396.title: Calling in the Cavalry

92397.description:
The nearby runestone has gone dark, and the Lightbloom is on its way. I can't hold this ground alone. Help me set the weapons, line up the potions, and get our supplies in order.

We'll meet that growth with discipline and precision and send it back in pieces.
92397.title: Dawnstar Defense

92398.description:
Brace yourself--the time is upon us!

Hold the line and keep them from reaching the runestone at all costs. I'll focus on restoring its power, but I need you to protect me and everyone here.

Are you ready?
92398.title: And Then They Came

92402.description:
Oh hey, just the person I was looking for!

Some of your neighbors are looking to get into enchanting. They aren't quite ready for prime time yet, but I have an idea to get them started.

It looks like there's an area in your neighborhood that has slight magical energy. Can you take this locator and find some crystals for them?

They only need to be slightly magical. We don't want them to cause an accident!
92402.title: Magical Touch

92405.description: Greetings, champion. I have an urgent message for you from Arator. He asks that you join him and his aunt Vereesa on Oztan Isle, off the coast to the west.
92405.title: Meet Arator

92407.description:
When Xal'atath departed she left behind a large number of anomalies, small pocket dimensions where enemies can hide. As Romuul calls them, "Hidey-Holes".

The Artificer has rigged up a device that should do the job.

We need to close these Hidey-Holes and flush out any enemies lurking inside.
92407.title: Hidey-Hole

92408.description:
How on Azeroth one of these encroaching paladins managed to come by such an exquisite example of Thalassian tailoring is beyond me. But it would be negligent of me to turn down this opportunity.

The materials we need are far more bespoke than I keep in my shop, however. We'll need to source our manasilk directly. Fortunately, it isn't far--just outside the city gates.

And at least there we'll be safe from these dabblers.
92408.title: Material Gains

92417.description:
Hey, it's {name}!

I'm in a bit of a pickle here. I'm making food for everyone, but underestimated how many people would turn up!

I can whip up a quick stew and the local farmers said I could use their produce, but the other dishes are at a vital point, I can't leave them unattended!

Could you gather some ripe ingredients, and bring them back?
92417.title: Farm to Table

92420.description:
Each year, as tribes from southern and central Kalimdor journeyed to Stonetalon to spend the summer season, the rite of the sun blossoms became common practice.

Many saw it as a way to give back to An'she, who worked tirelessly during this long season.

The rite became especially important towards the end of Midsummer, as the southern tribes journeyed back home.

If you're up for another journey, take to the skies once more, my friend, and listen close...
92420.title: Ignite the Skies: Southern Kalimdor

92429.description:
Hey there!

I'm working on a new method for making leather, but without harming animals.

I just need small samples, fur, saliva, that sort of thing. Nothing invasive.

I have this handy device that should help out!
92429.title: Alternative Skinning

92430.description: {name}, make haste to the Infinite Bazaar. I believe you are ready for a new kind of experiment.
92430.title: Embracing the Infinite Chaos

92435.description:
Midsummer is a time to reflect on the past and future. As old traditions fade, new traditions are born. 

One old tradition, practiced long ago, involved the offering of sun blossoms to An'she. As summer winds took them upwards, the blossoms would burn bright blue and orange.

But faded traditions need not remain lost.


Will you take to the skies to ignite the sun blossoms and help rekindle this old tradition?
92435.title: Ignite the Skies: Orgrimmar

92437.description:
Are you ready for today's challenge? I've hidden a piece from my collection here in the neighborhood. To find it, you must merely solve this simple riddle:

Stone laid by lost hands.
Bridging the mountain runoff.
Look where lilies listen.

Good luck!
92437.title: Decor Treasure Hunt

92439.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of fighting the Legion with their own power, so focus on using demonic fel energy to slay your foes.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92439.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Felrunner

92440.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the storm, so focus on fighting opponents by turning the tides quite literally.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92440.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Stormrunner

92441.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the arcane, so focus on fighting opponents with powerful magic.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92441.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Magerunner

92442.description:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the Light, so focus on wielding holy justice to smite your enemies.

And remember, this is for the greater good.
92442.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Lightrunner

92443.description:
Hey there, I was collecting herbs around your neighborhood, and I kind of zoned out, and lost track of time. It's so pretty here!

I think I may have picked too many herbs. I have an enchanted watering can that should help new ones grow back in, if you have the time to help them grow back?
92443.title: Reverse Herb Farming

92445.description:
People keep coming up to me and asking me about mining, I'm not a miner, I'm a smelter!

I'm looking to teach some people about smelting, but I've been struggling with getting a crowd.

Could you help me out while I talk you through smelting?
92445.title: Smelting for Two

92448.description:
You find a faintly glowing powder in your hands after catching the moth. It is fine, dry, and oddly luminous. 
It doesn't hum or shift, but it catches the light in a way that feels deliberate.

You recall Mothkeeper Wew'tam is known to have a particular interest in the moths that reside in Harandar.

Perhaps this dust would be of interest.
92448.title: Where Dust Dances

92450.description:
Oh, hi! You're new. I'm Ani. Dis is Jynx.

Have you been to de waterfall yet? All de kids dare each other to jump off, but I'm too scared.

Do you want to see it?
92450.title: Growing Up is Hard

92451.description:
Yeah, it's pretty far down.

But if I don't jump, dey'll make fun of me. Maybe if you cheer me on, I can do it?
92451.title: I Think I Can

92452.description:
<Ani's trinket bag sits in the soft mud of the river bank, but her trinkets are nowhere to be found.

If you're lucky, you may be able to follow her trail.>
92452.title: Not According to Plan

92453.description:
Those lizards were waitin' at de bottom and dragged me off!

Did you find my toys and stuff? I tried droppin' dem so someone could find me. I can't believe dat worked!

I think you scared dem off. It should be safe enough for Jynx to help me out of here.
92453.title: Fearless

92455.description:
Every Hallow's End, same thing... spirits crawl outta the dirt like they forgot they're dead.

We tried smashin'. We tried burnin'. Didn't work. Now we got these new tools some goblin made that'll take care of those ghosts.

Gear up and get goin'! Get enough of em to clear the streats for now, but don't go gettin' lazy. They always seem to find a way back.
92455.title: Specter Inspector

92492.description:
It's de hash'ura again. You willin' to help me, or does Zul'jarra got you on a short leash?

No? Then I got a job for you. One of my guards, Idago, was killed in de massacre at Revantusk Sedge. I wish to honor him with funeral rites. We Revantusk burn de bodies of our dead. But we don't have Idago's body.

So, I'm goin' back to de sedge to retrieve somethin' of his. We'll burn dat instead.

My honor guard Pel'na will not go and says it is too dangerous, but you'll keep me safe, won'tcha?
92492.title: Honorin' de Sacrifice

92493.description:
Idago was my most trusted guard. He was a mentor to me for as long as I remember. I never thought dat he would be taken from me so soon--and then de Twilight's Blade attacked us without warnin'.

Idago is de one that saved me from de village. He left his spear and his banner behind. I also left a note he gave me in case he...

Bring me those items. With dem, we can honor his strength and his loyalty--and send his spirit on.
92493.title: What Remains of Idago

92495.description:
Look at what these cultists did to Revantusk Sedge!

Dis was once a place of peace... dis was our home. An' dey are desecrating it.

I know we're here to retrieve Idago's things, but I won't be bothered if you take up arms against de Twilight's Blade.

Put dem in de ground. Show dem de ferocity of de bear.
92495.title: Disruptin' de Blade

92496.description:
Idago's still alive, {name}!

I saw him dragged up into de crypt, bound in magic runes. 

De cultists say dey are takin' him to some Deathchanter Mish'mosh. Dis cultist must be behind the death and destruction brought to our sedge.

For the honor of the people we lost, root this snake out of our home!
92496.title: Spears Against de Shadow

92497.description:
Who... Who are you? Who sent you? Lilaju?

De cultists massacred our village. I stayed behind to make sure everyone got out.

But de cultists captured me and now dey say dey got somethin' extra special for Idago. I'd rather not find out what.

Dis magic holdin' me here is amateur work. De spells to release de bindings are sure to be in de magical tomes de cultists brought here.

Find de tomes and rip some pages out. Then we can piece together de right words to release me.
92497.title: Simply Magical

92498.description:
Ahh, Hallow's End. The perfect time for spooky stories, glowing pumpkins, and sweet, sweet candy!

But this year, I want to craft something truly unforgettable. A delicious range of candy inspired from regions across Azeroth!

For that, I've enlisted some help. A certain... eccentric culinary genius. You may know him. I've sent him off to Drustvar in search of haunted recipes that are sure to thrill everyone.

Find him and bring back some of those cursed candies.
92498.title: Sugar Run

92499.description:
Idago reminded me dat my first obligation is to my tribe. I missed him dearly, but it was not right for me to put my own life--or yours--at risk to find him.

Pel'na tried to tell me this. I would not listen.

I must be a model for my people. I will allow de bear loa to guide my direction. Sometimes we must sacrifice de things we hold dear.

Nalorakk grant me strength and resilience.
92499.title: The Wisest Leaders Follow

92503.description:
Have you heard the tale of the wildsages and their summer star?

No? Well, you're in for quite the treat!

This story will take you on a journey that follows the path the Wildhammer elders once travelled many moons ago.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossom lights as I tell the tale.

Our journey begins here in the hills of Loch Modan...
92503.title: Ignite the Skies: Northern Eastern Kingdoms

92504.description:
The fire festival is a time for people to come together and share stories around the fire.

One such tale tells of a celebration of Midsummer and the elemental chaos it wrought for the humans of Stormwind.

Our story will take us over the skies of the surrounding regions into lands now scarred by flame and ash.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossom lights as I tell you the story.

It begins in the Burning Steppes...
92504.title: Ignite the Skies: Southern Eastern Kingdoms

92505.description:
Thanks for freeing me from those ethereal cages in the Ethereum Overcroft. The Void is powerful here in ways we're only beginning to understand, and that danger brings new opportunities.

If you remember, my quest to combine the power of the Void with the strength of the Illidari has not changed.

Backing Adarus was a mistake, but a necessary one to progress. And now I've found a willing teacher in Allari. I ask for your help again, {name}. Help me find the strength to protect my people.
92505.title: Truth of the Past

92506.description:
Argus.

Originally the homeworld of the Eredar, now the stronghold for the Burning Legion. Years ago, Illidan used the Seal of Argus to open the way here. And he was met by one of the naaru who delivered a dire message.

To understand the Illidari's connection to the Void, you must see what Illidan saw when he arrived. Hostile spirits in the area should provide the necessary power for our needs.

Defeat them to release their essence, and with their sacrifice we will peer into the past.
92506.title: The Soul Price

92507.description:
We have what we need.

Prepare yourself to see Illidan's confrontation with the naaru so many years ago.
92507.title: A More Potent Foe

92508.description:
The tattoos that mark our flesh are more than just ink. They're a promise inscribed across our flesh.

The promise that we will hold back the dark and the infernal with our very bodies. That our lifeblood is a currency used to purchase Azeroth's future.

Surprised? We are not simply rage and defiance manifest, although we are also that.

Help Leona collect the vitae of the void creatures at Nexus-Point Antius. We'll use it to inscribe her tattoos, affirming the vow she makes to protect her people.
92508.title: The Mark of Sacrifice

92509.description:
Voidstorm is a world of apex creatures. One in particular, the ultradon, stands above others in its strength and ferocity.

But make no mistake, {name}. We demon hunters are the true apex predators wherever we go, because we are willing to go to any length in order to dominate. I see no better creature to harvest an implement in which to inscribe Leona's tattoos.

Head to Nexus-Point Antius with Leona. Defeat as many ultradons as it takes to find the perfect implement.
92509.title: One Cruel Implement

92510.description:
The branding ritual we're about to perform is adapted from what demon hunters go through on the Fel Hammer. But given Leona's unique nature and the experimental substitution of Void energy for fel, there's considerable risk here. Even more so than usual.

Leona will be vulnerable during this process, as will I. We've found a secluded area to perform it, but we'll need your protection once we start.
92510.title: Dark Infusion

92511.description:
It may not surprise you to know that the stabilization of portal entry points is something I'm quite familiar with.

If Leona lives, and I believe she does, she'll need beacons to help triangulate her exit point. Take these beacons, set them up where I've marked on your map, and return here.

If Leona is alive, she should be able to use these beacons to identify and stabilize her exit.

If she isn't--

<Umbric pushes the thought away.>

Let's focus on the task at hand for now.
92511.title: Event Horizon

92512.description:
I'm not sure where I was when I stepped through that portal, {name}. Somewhere in between, Void energy surrounding and suffusing me.

Without Umbric, I wouldn't have made it back. I feel different now, but I don't think this is over until we confront that domanaar.

Will you meet us at the Voidspire?
92512.title: Devourer

92520.description:
The Sunwell--no... the Darkwell is overrun. 

Void-spawned creatures swarm the regions where our greatest champions of the Light held their ground to the very last.

Champion, can you survey Quel'Danas? Find any survivors? If you tag them with these tokens, our mages here will be able to teleport the individuals back. We must try to save as many as we can.
92520.title: Wake of the Darkwell

92531.description:
Everyone has their own path toward understanding, even Akutu--though he has yet to set foot on it, unfortunately.

My shrine was once a place of discovery and understanding for the Amani. Please take word to them that I welcome their return.

The ghosts will calm in time.
92531.title: The Medicine Loa's Shrine

92535.description: Truffles are simple enough to find if you've got a strong nose. Luckily, I can lend you one!
92535.title: Witchbane Truffles

92536.description: My favorite! Bewitched berries are quite tricky. There's no telling what will happen when you pick them!
92536.title: Bewitched Berry Bites

92537.description: Quite the risk taker! Honeycombs are delicious, but can be a pain to retrieve - literally! Don't expect a warm welcome from the habitants of the hives that you will be extracting honeycombs from.
92537.title: Hexed Honeycombs

92555.description:
The time of Dawnsummer Festal has long been a cherished season for our people.

Even during the years under the cold grasp of the Ghostlands, the people of Tranquillien strived to maintain this ancient celebration and bring a little light to these once-cold lands.

Now, warmth yourself by the bonfire and honor the flames of summer!
92555.title: Honor the Flame

92556.description:
A joyous Midsummer and Dawnsummer Festal upon you, {race}!

While celebrating around the bonfire, it is important to pause for a moment of reflection.

Much has happened here in Silvermoon in recent times and while we cannot dwell upon the darkness of the past, we must look towards the rising Dawn.

Take a moment, while you honor the bonfire, and reflect upon its warmth!
92556.title: Honor the Flame

92557.description:
Fetna Alai-nazdo is upon us once again!

Although her trample may be dark, her flame burns brightly in all of us! 

May this turn of the Season burn bright and bring good fortune to you and all who celebrate Fetna Alai-nazdo!
92557.title: Honor the Flame

92558.description:
I remember the Dawnsummer Festal celebrations back in Eversong and thought 'why not light my own bonfire here in the Howling Ridge?'

Thankfully, the local denizens didn't need much convincing.

I told them the bonfires were sacrificial wells for vessels of esoteric magic and... well, that's one way to describe midsummer blossoms, right?

Will you take a moment and honor the voidflame?
92558.title: Honor the Flame

92559.description:
The season of Midsummer may be unfamiliar to us, but telling stories by the glow of our root flames is not.

Take a moment to reflect by the bonfire, friend, and listen to those around you.

Ponder that which has come before you and that which has yet to unfurl.
92559.title: Honor the Flame

92563.description:
<As you equip the jewelry, you feel it surge with power, flowing through you and into your artifact weapon.

The jewelry has unlocked hidden potential of your artifact weapon, enabling and empowering one of its traits.

Moratari will want to record this data.>
92563.title: Awoken by Accessory

92572.description:
Greetings! I see you are eyeing our fine furniture.

My siblings and I were sent on a mission to find only the finest Decor in the land.

Decor is more than furniture, you see. Crafting a truly great decoration requires attention to so many different details.

Come, friend, let us go on that journey together! Starting today. Today, we find a crate. Not just a normal crate, one that is fantastic. A great crate.

I hear they may sell them nearby, actually...
92572.title: Furniture Favor

92577.description:
A crate is nothing more than a box in the dark without lighting. 

Today, we go in search of the tiny suns that light our spaces. 

Not just any light will suffice. As you can clearly see from my chandelier, we have many lights of varying quality already.

We seek a unique shape, a unique feel. 

The crafters of Bel'ameth in the Dragon Isles are well-known for their dream-inspired designs. Travel through the Dragon Isles and you will find them at the far end of the plains.
92577.title: Dreamy Inspiration

92578.description:
The chandelier I showed you? You must think it so fancy. 

But here I am without the matching sconces!

What room lighting can I create without matching sconces? It will be woefully incomplete!

Head over to the Dragon Isles and see if you can find one from the vendors of Valdrakken.
92578.title: Draconic Decor

92580.description:
We cannot enjoy our Decor designs without a place to enjoy them from. 

Behold, the chair.

What better way to enjoy Decor than on Decor itself?

I cannot imagine something more appropriate.

Find me a chair to match this coil. The gearcrafters of Mechagon know the style.
92580.title: Spare A Chair

92581.description:
I have sat in the chair and looked at the lights, and yet I am still not satisfied. 

The Decor still does not strike the dramatic tone that we require.

I must trouble you for another source of the light's rays. 

Travel to Suramar and speak to the crafters there. They are masters of the art of soft lighting.
92581.title: Last Light

92600.description:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash though your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?
92600.title: Cracked Keystone

92603.description:
<The void elf writhes in a fitful sleep, tormented by the nearby shade.

Perhaps you should try to wake him.>
92603.title: O Lonely Star

92604.description:
After my failed creation, I sought wisdom from the Void, and it told me of this place.

There was a voice--strange, yet familiar. It promised a tool for shaping Void and shadow--something that would free me from my failure, but the Void gives nothing freely. We must command it, and violence is this land's mother tongue.

Slay the beasts here and bring me their ichor. We'll use it to write our demands.
92604.title: Speak in Blood

92605.description:
If ichor is to be the carrier for our message, bone shall be its pigment. This is a place of scavengers, with bones stolen from across this land: old, new, all carrying the echoes of violence that brought their ends.

Bring me bone splinters and I will powder them for our ink.

Please hurry. This shade is a wrong thing, and I must put it right.
92605.title: Honest as Bone

92606.description:
This place--this wound--is what the voice from the Void told me I'd find. There's something waiting inside... something to put an end to this broken creation.

<Orin winces and glares at the shade.>

You can't hear it? It howls. Sometimes in rage. Other times it sounds so lonely that it breaks my heart.

Ignore it. With the proper runes written in ichor and bone, I believe we can open this rift wider. Then you can seize what lies within.
92606.title: Take Up Your Gift

92607.description:
This is what the voice from the Void promised me: the means to divest myself of this shade.

You'll have to wield it. Don't worry--it won't harm me. It will separate me from the shade. Then it should simply fade away, no more than an unmoored shadow.

Go on. I'm ready.
92607.title: And Carve New Shapes

92608.description:
I'm having just the best time in your lovely village, it's so quaint!

I'm feeling inspired. I would like to paint a landscape picture to commemorate the occasion. But you know the area better than I.

Could you provide me with some pictures of the landscape I can use for inspiration? You can use my camera. It's top of the line, of course.

I'm sure the perfect spots will just beam at you.
92608.title: Landscape Photography

92616.description:
Brakko sorry that Brakko let {name} and TeamName down.

Brakko is much scared of sporegliders. Could sneak up at Brakko above cap, where cannot see. Could really hurt cap!

Very sorry, {name}. Brakko doesn't think Brakko can be tank for team.

Unless... {name} practice sporegliders with Brakko?
92616.title: Mushrooming Courage

92617.description:
First Tuktuk runs, then Brakko runs. Cannot be the only one still fighting.

Ziny will fail by Ziny's self. Fight is too hard alone, will not be strong enough.

Do not want to fail. Cannot let PH_Teamname down!

Had choice, fail or run.

But run was also fail. Ziny very sorry to {name}!

Can practice, fight big and scary enemies together?
92617.title: Mushrooming Resilience

92618.description:
Tuktuk's poison is not good enough. Tuktuk had to run, before we lose.

Sorry if you lose! Tuktuk did not lose. Tuktuk quit. Quit is safe from lose.

Grudge Pit very, rrr... is so intense. Tuktuk cannot handle. Tuktuk will stay out where is safe.

Tuktuk will find place to relax. Away from Grudge Pit.

Tuktuk cannot lose if stay far away.
92618.title: Mushrooming Confidence

92630.description:
I bring word from Magister Umbric!

His apprentice, Leona, has been preoccupied with a desire to learn how the ways of the Illidari.

She apparently found another demon hunter willing to train her, should she prove herself worthy. But after what happened the last time she sought such a mentor, Umbric is concerned for her safety.

Umbric requests you join Leona for this trial. Make sure she is not getting involved in something she is not prepared to handle.
92630.title: The Pursuit Continues

92631.description:
Leona must demonstrate mastery of her weapons--and of her own enmity--by retrieving undamaged pieces of her kills.

I will observe from here.

You, {name}, will go with her.
92631.title: Abhorrent Gauntlet

92632.description:
Cutting through scores of lesser foes is a simple task for any demon hunter. It's when we face a large, singular threat that our skills are truly tested.

That will be Leona's trial. You will act as her second.

Let us see how she vanquishes a particularly dangerous opponent.
92632.title: Trial of Wrath

92634.description:
While Midsummer may be sacred to the tauren, we are not the only people to pay respects to the spirits of fire during the summer months.

The Wildhammer, for example, have shared their own customs with us over the years. It seems this time of year has long been important to the dwarves and denizens of the Eastern Kingdoms.

Journey to their celebration grounds across the sea in Loch Modan and visit with the Wildhammer. 

Perhaps they too will tell you a tale...
92634.title: Midsummer's Journey to Loch Modan

92635.description:
Although we have our own traditions during this time, we are not the only ones who pay respects to the spirits of fire during the summer months.

If you wish to hear the origins of the tauren traditions, travel to Kalimdor to continue your journey.
92635.title: Midsummer's Journey to the Barrens

92647.description:
Champion! The curiosities hidden within the Shadowlands are numerous, as are the dangers. I could use some assistance clearing a path, so to speak.

There is much wealth to be gained should you choose to seek it.
92647.title: A Shadowed Journey Through Time

92650.description:
The strange anima shimmers with a gentle hum, barely larger than a candle. As your hand draws near it erupts, flooding your mind with a torrent of visions. Triumphs earned through blood, regrets etched in grief, serene stillness all too fleeting, the bitter taste of betrayal. The unbearable cascade threatens to shatter your mind like glass. 

Then, silence. The visions end leaving an image Oribos seared into your mind.
92650.title: The Flickering Anima

92652.description: Thrall is well known for his heroics. You would be hard pressed to find someone who hasn't at least heard of him. I will be focusing on his more recent moments, rather than older history.
92652.title: Lorewalking: Warchief, Shaman, Hero

92657.description:
Our foothold in Stormarion is tenuous at best. We're barely holding the enemy off on one front. We certainly don't have the forces to assault the rest of the citadel.

That's where you and I come in. Meet me in Stormarion Citadel when you're ready to get to work.
92657.title: The Brewing Storm

92658.description:
All our forces are focused on this courtyard, but I think we've got another problem. I've scouted between assaults: there's activity in the lower keep. Not to worry you, but there are signs of another singularity.

Up for a little reconnaissance? We'll go through the trench. They've got an impressive operation for gathering Void energy. Might as well hit that on the way. After all, our defenses here can't power themselves.

If I'm wrong, we can tell Maella we were proactively shoring up supply lines.
92658.title: Tactical Acquisition

92659.description:
