I've got a hunch I need to follow in the lower keep, and that means going through the trench. I hate to miss targets of opportunity, and the Host's energy collecting operation is right there.

How do you feel about wrecking their production capacity? The longer it takes them to recover, the easier it'll be to maintain the offensive up here.

It's not complicated. If it looks useful to the enemy, smash it. After that, we'll move onto the main objective in the keep itself.
92659.title: Resource Denial

92660.description:
Yes, there may be another unstable singularity. No, I didn't tell anyone. We don't have enough forces to divert our attention--that's why I asked you to accompany me. Besides, we've only got the one Singularity Anchor.

Don't worry though, I've got a plan. These domanaar are experts on shaping the Void, so they must have some means of controlling singularities. Get in there and grab any tools that look important.

We'll find a way to stabilize this singularity ourselves.
92660.title: Null Implements

92661.description:
I don't approve of Lysikas's disregard for duty, but I do trust his instincts. If he says there's something here we need to see, then he's probably right.

Even if he's wrong, we shouldn't waste this opportunity. A domanaar weaponsmith and researcher does his work from here. With most of the Stormarion forces attacking our Singularity Anchor, he should be an easy target. Take him out.
92661.title: Hammer Meet Anvil

92662.description:
This singularity could reach critical mass at any moment. We've no time to evacuate. It will devour our forces in the upper citadel, maybe even the Ingress.

Will you handle the tools? I've no idea how they work, but you've used more artifacts and seen more strange magic than most. Remember, the Void responds to will. Use the tools and command the singularity to stabilize. I trust you'll figure out the rest.

The Host will try to stop us. Lay down some defenses, then I'll cover you while you work.
92662.title: Core Collapse

92667.description:
Thrall's parents had lost their life while he was an infant - the start of a rough upbringing. Found by humans, he was raised within the internment camps from the Second War. The one in charge, a man named Blackmoore, was a terribly cruel taskmaster.

A rare friend during that time, Taretha Foxton, promised to help Thrall escape from his shackles.
92667.title: UNUSED

92671.description:
Let us keep the focus on Thrall, yes?

The Horde's history is expansive - and fascinating. Perhaps we can learn about it another time.

This period denotes the beginning of our hero's restlessness. His time as warchief now over by his own reckoning. Clinging to something he had learned in his journeys, he sought out the Earthen Ring and continued his studies of shamanism. But the life he left behind shadowed him every step of the way...
92671.title: Lorewalking: Rise of the Horde

92672.description:
The Cataclysm upended both Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. But it is from these wounds where Thrall showed Azeroth what he was truly capable of.

Azeroth needed a Shaman to take care of Deathwing, and they got one.
92672.title: UNUSED

92673.description:
Thrall left the Horde behind with the hope that the foundation he had laid would lead them towards the future.

Unfortunately turmoil quickly followed - Garrosh, the young orc Thrall had named as warchief, had a very different idea on what the Horde should be. One that left a major scar on Azeroth.
92673.title: Lorewalking: In Pride's Wake

92675.description:
After Garrosh's death, Thrall found himself doubting his abilities. And so he made a choice - his new path would be his family.

They retreated back into Outland, where his ancestors once lived, and found personal peace. All the while, Azeroth was facing a new war - one that could burn everything he had once fought for to the ground.
92675.title: Lorewalking: The Weight of Doubt

92676.description:
Thrall was at a crossroads, stuck between what he once was and what he should be.

And his hesitation affected more than just his mental state. The elements he once commanded effortlessly barely whispered a response to his call. The hero was held down by his own perception of the past.

But an answer that helped him push forward would come - amusingly, from the same past that haunted him.
92676.title: Lorewalking: In Another's Footsteps

92677.description:
We have just about reached the end of my tale, despite Thrall's story continuing.

It is hard to tell a story that hasn't been finished yet.

But I have no doubt we will continue to see great things from Thrall. Warchief, shaman, hero of Azeroth, Go'el. May he forge forward with all of his names in pride.
92677.title: Lorewalking: Paths Ever Onward

92688.description: <Erus will be delighted to scrap this for you for a heaping sum of bronze.>
92688.title: Bronze Simulacrum

92689.description:
{name}, today will be a day of ceremonies and great magic.

Before we begin to cleanse the Darkwell, agreements must be made. 

We have two events that have requested your presence, both as a mediator and as a witness. What we lay down today will have lasting ramifications, and it is important to all of us that we have you at the center of it all. 

Meet with Aethas and Rommath for their respective events. Once you are done, return here and we shall continue to the Darkwell together.
92689.title: A Path Forward

92692.description:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Foreman Eksos in Talador.

The Iron Horde seek to control Talador. The area is perfect to send reinforcements to any other part of Draenor quickly and without resistance.

Foreman Eksos is currently establishing an outpost in Talador. Travel there and stop the Iron Horde.

Glory to the Alliance!
92692.title: Hero's Call: Test!

92694.description:
As Zur'ashar, our oath is to safeguard the harmony within the visions and the histories we preserve.

Yet Orn'shan's crude strokes are reckless. Their creative impulses lack refinement, disturbing the balance we are sworn to protect. In a misguided attempt at creativity, they've created uncontrollable chaos and are distorting the very truths they sought to record.

Perhaps they will heed the words of an outsider before their reputation collapses entirely.
92694.title: Dusk Among Pigments

92695.description:
I... I don't think I can mend this. The Zur'ashar were right. I am no true paintmaker. I cannot even capture history properly within my own memories... how could I ever hope to honor it in moments that matter?

I thought I could create something beautiful... something worthy. I was foolish to try.

Can you... can you help me clean this mess? I... I have no hope left to do it myself.
92695.title: The Stroke of Storms

92696.description:
Outsider... thank you. I'm still shaken... but I can feel a small spark returning. I'd nearly abandoned my work entirely, yet your kindness... it has steadied me.

I think I finally see what I'm meant to create: something meaningful that honors the Zur'ashar tradition through my voice, but to begin, I need the raw essence of color itself.

Will you help me collect the ingredients I need? I'd be looking for anything I can use to turn into paint.
92696.title: Colors Born Anew

92697.description:
I... never expected to feel this again. Your help has given me hope. These ingredients feel right, and maybe even enough.

I want you to be the first to paint. Do not fret over perfection. Paint what you feel, and I'll capture its essence into the memory I preserve.

I look forward to see what you create.
92697.title: Hues of Tomorrow

92711.description:
Welcome to the Midsummer Festival of Fire, friend!

Have you come to toss a few torches? Or maybe dance around the maypole?

Ah, you must be here to ignite the blossom lights over the skies of Stormwind, aren't you? It is an old tradition, long forgotten but newly rekindled!

Well, come on then. Take to the skies and fly!
92711.title: Ignite the Skies: Stormwind

92713.description:
The relics you restored still hum with the visions you once walked.

Their stories yearn to be lived again, and each retelling leaves the world just a little richer than before.

Return them to the shrines, let the memories flow, and I shall place in your hands a reward for one who walks the paths of legend.
92713.title: Echoes Rekindled

92715.description:
Fancy yourself a Brawl'gar contender do you, {class}? They don't let just anyone in there, you know. Certainly not without an invitation.

That said... just between you and me, if you know where to look and you've the means they say anyone can have their moment in the spotlight these days.
92715.title: By Invitation Only?

92716.description:
You have walked this path before, {name}, yet the Vale of Secrets stirs anew.

The Visionstone awaits, its sacred paintings familiar to your eyes, the handprint at its heart calling for you again.
Press your hand upon it once more and let your spirit be known. The trance will take you as before, carrying your soul through visions whose truths still shift with every telling.

Return to me with what new wisdom the echoes grant you.
92716.title: The Story of Wey'nan's Ward

92719.description:
Once more, the Cauldron of Echoes stirs.

When I first walked the path of the Zur'Ashar, my master spoke of its place at our beginning. Even they could not grasp its full meaning. Now, it beckons again.

Step into its quiet and draw forth what the ages have hidden. Bring me the truth as it speaks to you this time.
92719.title: The Story of the Cauldron of Echoes

92720.description:
The bloom still waits, its stillness carrying the same quiet call you once followed.

Yet the bloom's story deepens with each telling. Walk its path again, let the stillness speak anew, and see what more the goddess chooses to share.
92720.title: The Story of Aln'hara's Bloom

92721.description:
The Echoless Flame rests as you left it, yet the air around it stirs once more.

You have walked Obayo's path before, felt the echo of that first Shul'ka's purpose. But the past is a shifting thing, and the Flame's silence may yet hide verses you have not heard.

Return to its vigil. Follow Obayo's steps again, and let the vision show you what remains untold.
92721.title: The Story of the Echoless Flame

92722.description:
The spear still waits where you last left it, pale threads of mushroom slowly weaving new patterns into its grain.

The culling grounds draw you again. Walk their softened paths, follow what spores still rise, and let the visions show what time has chosen to reveal this season.
92722.title: The Story of Russula's Outreach

92724.description:
The Root of the World stands as it did before--ancient, unbowed--yet the soil breathes differently today. Beneath your feet, the pulse of Harandar quickens, as though eager to share another verse of its oldest story.

You have seen through Ruilla the Huntress's eyes once before. But the Rootways are never walked the same way twice. Go again, and let the land decide which truths it will show you now.
92724.title: The Story of the Root of the World

92725.description:
Sky's Hope rests in its cradle as before, yet the heavens above seem sharper tonight.

You have traced Awe'ohna's path once, but the tale shifts with every telling. Walk the path again, and perhaps the sky will tilt just so, revealing a truth you missed before.
92725.title: The Story of Sky's Hope

92728.description:
That dog! It ran through here and disrupted every lesson on the schedule. Now there are fire elementals everywhere and my students are ill-prepared to handle this mess. How am I supposed to teach in all of this chaos?

You look capable--would you clear out some of these rowdy little elementals? The sooner we get this situation under control, the better!
92728.title: Dogged Disturbances

92729.description:
Gilneas and Kul Tiras are both known for their hunting hounds. With the resurgence of elfhounds in Silvermoon, I thought perhaps they could be similarly utilized. They're dogs, after all. How hard could training possibly be?

Long story short, that dog made a mess and dashed off. I have to clean this up. 

Would you please find that creature and bring him back to me before the local canine cafe has my head? I only borrowed him for the day!
92729.title: Hounded and Hassled

92732.description:
We have had victories against the Lightbloom, but Alndust is rare. Until we can gather more, the Lightbloom continues its spread. Our forces are stretched too thin to watch their every movement.

A scout spotted a strange corpse by the road to the east, along with a report of a general disturbance of the light-cursed creatures. I can't look into both at once. Could you find that corpse while I investigate deeper into the Encroaching Bloom?
92732.title: Light Disturbance

92736.description: <These potatoad creatures are seldom seen near the Lightbloom. It is covered in spores and looks like it was trying to escape. You should search for more clues.>
92736.title: Light Stroll

92737.description:
The Lightbloom has infected many of these potatoads and spurred them into a frenzy. They spread the spores and reproduce at a dangerous rate.

If we don't act, we will be overrun. Will you cull this heard while I search for the source of the corruption?
92737.title: Light Carnage

92738.description:
It is too late for the adults, but the young may still be saved. If you can capture them, we can remove the spores before they take root.

Gather up the spore covered potadpoles and bring them to me. I will take them to Har'alnor myself to purge this Lightbloom.

Do not let their first breaths be their last. Please, {name}: save the babies.
92738.title: Potatoad Tots

92739.description:
I have discovered the lair of a cunning creature I call Adzikel. With luck, this name will soon be forgotten. 

Adzikel sneaks into the potatoad nests to steal their young, and plants the Lightbloom spores to accelerate their growth into the frenzied toads, which spread more spores.

For the little ones to have a chance, I must return to Har'alnor, but you have earned the right to slay this beast. Go with honor, and finish the hunt!
92739.title: O.K. Bloomer

92740.description:
Well {class}, it's your lucky day. I just happen to have an extremely genuine Brawler's Guild Invitation right here in my stockpile.

That said I'll need a moment to process the paperwork. That requires my complete concentration without your prying eyes on me. So do please give me a moment.
92740.title: Questionable Qualifications

92816.description:
<You look down to see a rough looking letter with your name on it.

Why not open it up to see what's inside?>
92816.title: A Letter for Adventure

92821.description:
The season of Midsummer is celebrated by many cultures across Azeroth.

Even now, bonfires across the land are ignited in honor of the spirits of fire.

To share our customs with all who dwell under the sun's warmth, I've had crates of sun blossoms brought to Silvermoon.

Take to the skies and ignite the blossoms above, {name}!
92821.title: Ignite the Skies: Silvermoon

92826.description:
Where to begin? There's so much to say!

There's a great story from the Zandalari about the connection between troll and loa. Let's start there!
92826.title: Lorewalking: The Loa of Kings

92829.description:
The Drakkari of Zul'Drak are well known for massacring their loa. The prophets of the Drakkari loa decided to take the full power of the loa by force.

The loa were blind-sided by this betrayal. They never dreamed rituals existed that could permanently kill them and steal their essence.
92829.title: Lorewalking: Death of the Drakkari Loa

92831.description:
Not every loa is a protector and companion to trolls. There are loa that eat their followers, like the blood loa, Hakkar. In trade for sacrifices, Hakkar grants dark blood powers to his followers. But he always takes more than he gives.

Hakkar the Soulflayer has absorbed so much blood from his cultists that he's become almost a perpetual threat to the world.
92831.title: Lorewalking: The Blood Loa

92832.description:
The last story I want to share is about the Darkspear trolls... and Mueh'zala.

Mueh'zala is a mighty Loa of Death. Highly manipulative, he puts his plans into motion by using others as his pawns.

He's used a hash'ey in the past. A hash'ey is a troll imbued with the full power of the loa.
92832.title: Lorewalking: The Hash'ey

92836.description:
Welcome to the Midsummer Festival of Fire, friend! 

Have you come to toss a few torches? Or maybe dance around the maypole?

Ah, you must be here to ignite the blossom lights over the skies of Stormwind, aren't you? It is an old tradition, long forgotten but newly rekindled!

Well, come on then, take to the skies and fly!
92836.title: Reignite the Skies: Stormwind

92839.description:
Midsummer is a time to reflect on the past and future. As old traditions fade, new traditions are born. 

One old tradition, practiced long ago, involved the offering of sun blossoms to An'she. As summer winds took them upwards, the blossoms would burn bright blue and orange.

But faded traditions need not remain lost.


Will you take to the skies to ignite the sun blossoms and help rekindle this old tradition?
92839.title: Reignite the Skies: Orgrimmar

92845.description:
Fancy yourself a Brawlpub contender do you, {class}? They don't let just anyone in there, you know. Certainly not without an invitation.

That said... just between you and me, if you know where to look and you've the means they say anyone can have their moment in the spotlight these days.
92845.title: By Invitation Only?

92851.description:
Well {class}, it's your lucky day. I just happen to have an extremely genuine Brawler's Guild Invitation right here in my stockpile.

That said I'll need a moment to process the paperwork. That requires my complete concentration without your prying eyes on me. So do please give me a moment.
92851.title: Questionable Qualifications

92857.description: This token bears the seal of Overseer Ta'readon in Oribos. They would be interested in seeing this.
92857.title: Ta'readon's Mount Voucher

92864.description:
With the hydras hunted out of the area, the drifter population in the cascades to the west is on the rise. Egg sacks are making the water murky and undrinkable, and the drifters are becoming very territorial.

We must ensure that the reintroduction of the hydras will succeed. We need to cull the number of drifters and clear some of their egg sacks.

You look like someone capable of doing this task. Will you help me?
92864.title: Drift Them Away

92865.description:
The orchid hydra's favorite food is the violet chloroceros--especially the buds on the bull's back.

With the hydras gone for so long, the violet chloroceros grazed too much of the fauna. Soon, there will only be mud in that once lush and beautiful part of Harandar.

I want to introduce my hydras to their primary source of food, and I would appreciate it if you could bring me four of those buds.
92865.title: Feeding the Buds

92866.description:
With the previous tasks done, it is time to reintroduce the budlings to the wilds.

I have marked suitable locations to place the budlings. The little hydras will be an easy pick, so expect predators to attack you.

I am sad to see them go. However, I know it is for the ecosystem's and their own good.
92866.title: Re-Hydra-ted

92868.description:
You've been invaluable, {name}. As for that little menace, after he was done wreaking havoc here, I didn't really pay attention to where he went next. I'm sure you'll find him eventually. 

Let's hope you do before he wrecks half the city, hmm?
92868.title: He Went Thataway

92869.description: That dog tore right through the pond and sent half the sunwhiskers flying right out of the water! Quickly, get them back in the pond before they perish!
92869.title: Fishy Dis-pondencies

92870.description:
That dog! The last I saw he was tearing through the pond. I didn't see where he went, but he has to be nearby!

His barks... they haunt me...
92870.title: Scoot Along Now

92875.description:
I fear your time in Valdrakken must come to an end.

Dark forces gather to threaten other parts of Azeroth. We will do what we can to uncover Iridikron's schemes.

You must learn more of what has unfolded.
92875.title: Understanding the War Within

92882.description:
I am desperate enough to ask an outsider for help.

To join the Ka'dani, the elite hunters of Har'athir, you must complete a ritual under the guidance of an experienced Ka'dani. However, there are none left to guide me, so I cannot take the trial.

But I have heard words of your actions. Maybe Akazi, the Ka'dani Elder, would let you stand as my guide. You may not know the ritual, but you know the hunt.

Please, let us speak to Elder Akazi. We must try.
92882.title: A Hunter's Plight

92883.description:
At the start of the trial, the mentor and trainee gather materials to forge a hunting weapon.

The weapon is more than an extension of the Ka'dani-- it's part of their being. There is no other weapon like it, as each is unique.

You will help Ketan hunt and gather the materials and decorations, as well as a gift for the weaponsmith.
92883.title: A Hunter's Duty

92884.description:
Forging the Ka'dani weapon is a crucial moment in the trial. We will have to follow Al'yaat's instructions.

Once Al'yaat forges the weapon, you will bring it to Elder Akazi.

There will be a short ceremony where he will hand me the weapon. The ceremony concludes with the elder announcing our final task.

I shouldn't let the excitement take the better of me, but one thing at a time. We must be patient and calculated as if we were on a hunt.
92884.title: A Hunter's Weapon

92885.description:
The last trial stands before you. Together, you have forged a weapon that will fell any beast, but the weapon is nothing without the hunter.

Since you are not a Ka'dani, I present you with a difficult hunt. Ketan and you will hunt down and slay a prey known to all Har'athir hunters: the great Radooni. The beast ventured too close to Har'athir and should be a suitable hunt.

Return to me once your hunt is complete and Radooni's sap is on the spear.
92885.title: A Hunter's Prey

92895.description:
Hagar has a message she believes the elves and trolls of Azeroth must all hear. She has sent a call to leaders from the elven and troll tribes to come to Harandar.

I have come here to ask the blood elves to join us, but you should be there as well. You have been with us through so much of this.

The Rootways from Silvermoon would be the fastest way.
92895.title: Hagar's Invitation

92897.description:
{name},

I bear an important message from Hagar. You are invited to a special meeting in Harandar. Please meet me in Silvermoon to discuss it.

Orweyna
92897.title: The Preparations Are Complete

92899.description:
Hagar requested that we invite to this meeting all of the troll and elven leaders we know.

It was not easy to convince them to come. There are some... past grievances between these groups. Hagar hopes to overcome these divisions.

As we wait for the others to arrive, feel free to speak to the other delegates. The wait is making them restless, so try not to inflame tensions.
92899.title: History Lesson

92900.description:
Zul'jarra could not leave Zul'Aman as the Amani still recover. She sent Zul'jan in her stead.

She hoped showing trust and giving him dis responsibility would bring him out of her shadow. Make use of his talents. But dis news...

I am an old troll. I have a hard time reining Zul'jan in, but he may listen to you.

Would you join us? Zul'jarra and I would be grateful if Zul'jan stayed out of trouble.
92900.title: A Favor for Kinduru

92901.description:
Not all of the visions in this place were clear to us. Some of them were... strange.

One in particular seemed to revolve around an unfamiliar people: a people that we learned are the Amani trolls.

The magic used to create the painting, to pull the memories from the past, are tied to the haranir and those close to us. If there was no connection, the Zur'ashar--who create the paintings--could not have recalled troll history.

I can show you and Zul'jan, and you can judge for yourselves.
92901.title: Revisionist History

92903.description: The third vision shows Ula'tek and the amani fighting against the enemies of the amani. You help them fight. Zul'jan is a talking head during this sequence.
92903.title: Fight Alongside Ula'tek

92904.description:
I have heard de story since I was a child! De Amani were outnumbered and still dey fought on! Dey claimed victory through sheer will!

Orweyna says de visions cannot lie. Uncle thinks details of de battle could have been lost. Dey would question everything it means to be Amani.

<Zul'jan scowls.>

I must find de truth of dis. Uncle says if anyone would know, it would be de loa. De loa have said nothing of dis before, but we must start somewhere.

It's time to go home.
92904.title: Return to Zul'Aman

92905.description: You go find Uncle Kinduru. Uncle doesn't know anything about Ula'tek but can ask the eagle loa. You help him perform a ritual to ask the loa. He says the loa don't know either.
92905.title: Help Uncle with Loa

92907.description:
My uncle has already started communin' with de loa to find information on dis Ula'tek. Meanwhile, we gonna dig through his boxes to see what we can find.

<Zul'jan points to all the boxes scattered around the terrace.>

My uncle has de biggest collection of histories among de Amani. I used to read through dem when I was a boy.

Look for anything about Ula'tek, snakes, or early Amani history. I'll take these, you search de others.
92907.title: Amani Answers

92916.description:
{name}, I call upon you to aid the Amani again as a fellow hash'ura. Another dire threat is upon them.

Malacrass has returned.

Witherbark Bluffs is under attack by a monstrous enemy the likes of which I have never seen. And with our brush against the Twilight's Blade, the timing could not be worse.

Zul'jan deserted us and... we believe he may be at least partially at fault.

We will deal with both of them in time. For now, help us before we are overrun.
92916.title: A Call for Aid

92917.description:
<Liadrin wipes sweat from her brow and addresses you without turning. You see minor cuts and scrapes she has neglected to heal.>

We fell back from the town gates. There were so many wounded and poisoned. Orweyna, Tak'lejo, and I best serve the Amani here.

But you should be out there helping Zul'jarra.

Malacrass's serpents are capturing Witherbark, coiling around them, and filling them with poison.

Free them--and make sure to find Dak'zor. He was on the front line and first to fall.
92917.title: Saving Those Bound

92919.description:
The wounds I have seen... the ferocity.

Not only do these serpents slither on the ground and coil around our warriors' bodies, but they cut deep with their poisoned blades and target them with their talons as they dive from the skies.

Zul'jarra and her forces cannot win this on their own, but my hands are needed here. 

Help Zul'jarra by taking them down.
92919.title: All Bark, All Bite

92920.description:
I will need some time to call upon Akil'zon and open de way. Dat's where you come in.

Protect me, my hash'ura.

I entrust you with my life. We've taken great leaps before, eh?
92920.title: Down With the Skies

92921.description:
<Zul'jarra's face is dark with rage as she looks off toward the Skybridge.>

Zul'jan... you let dat snake Malacrass taint your mind and heart. For what? Power?

De lightwood was one thing. But dis?

I don't know what Malacrass has planned for de captives, but we have to take de fight to him and away from our people.

Follow de monsters' path back to de Skybridge. I will consult de loa and meet you there.

With their help, we will stop this.
92921.title: To the Skybridge

92922.description: Zal'jarra also asks us to rescue a few people!
92922.title: Those Who Can't Fight

92924.description:
With de loa, we are powerful. Without de loa, we are still the Amani. We will get our kin back.

Liadrin will join us soon with reinforcements, and my warriors are eager to take vengeance.

There can be no delay. For my people's sake and for Zul'jan's.
92924.title: What Lies Beyond the Fog

92925.description:
The ruins across this island are ancient, built by the Amani long ago. If we discover how they came to be here, we may learn the truth of Ula'tek.

Then we can show Zul'jan what he is really chasing.

I have an idea of where to look for that crypt. Let us go together, {name}.
92925.title: The Glint of History

92926.description:
Ah, {name}. I am glad to see you here in our city, even if the times are trying.

We are once again beset on all sides by uncertain friends and dangerous foes, but I am not unprepared. I have a... guest, housed nearby. They may hold the key to our city's survival. 

Meet me near the harbor if you have the strength to do what must be done.
92926.title: Prey: Astalor's Initiative

92927.description:
Sometimes the goddess' visions are not easy to understand at first, but in time she reveals her intentions.

I will keep the Children of Ula'tek out of your path as you follow her memories.

Trust that she will reveal what we need to learn.

Meet me up ahead once you have witnessed her memories of the Amani.
92927.title: Echoed Steps

92928.description:
The visions of Nek'zali led us here. That we found where she took her last breath is no coincidence.

There must be something within this crypt that the goddess wishes for us to see.

Zul'jarra bid us to find the truth of Ula'tek. Perhaps here we will find the answers we seek.

Let us see where the story we were told in the Den of Echoes ends, and where the truth begins.
92928.title: What Was Buried

92929.description:
Those who built this crypt would not have sealed it without good reason.

A great evil from the past must dwell here.

We should put to rest any spirits and undead we find. They cannot keep us from the answers we seek.
92929.title: Lurking in the Dark

92930.description:
A version of this history is written into the Den of Echoes. The same events, only recorded by Amani hands instead of haranir ones. 

But something is missing: Nek'zali. How is she part of the story of Ula'tek? 

And we do not know how Ula'tek came to this world.

We must go deeper into the crypt and witness the truth written on its walls.
92930.title: Written by the Victors

92931.description:
The wound from Zul'jan's blade. It won't heal.

Zul'jan must have poisoned her. She's weakening, and I have not been successful in curing her with Light.

<Liadrin engulfs Zul'jarra in Light again. Nothing changes.>

Blast it!

Whatever you found in that crypt can wait.

The Amani are trying to find a cure. Ask Raz'taka if he's made any progress.

If you need anything else, talk to Tak'lejo. Zul'jarra needs to focus on recovering.
92931.title: Delay the Venom

92932.description:
Look in the distance. Restless, evil energy fills the sky. That structure ahead must have the answers we seek.

The creatures that stand in our way must be culled. We cannot risk being overcome on such a vital mission.
92932.title: Clear the Swamp

92933.description:
With Zul'jarra down, de Amani are losin' heart with each passin' moment. We gotta do somethin' to show dem that dis isn't over.

Those tortollans have been helpin' where they can. Let's repay de favor and help out de captain. 

Seein' a bunch of their lost crew return to town oughta give dem some hope in dis cursed land.
92933.title: Haunted Shore

92934.description:
<Your loyal follower keeps her voice low as you approach.>

As you foretold, red rain falls from de sky. De heavens align. A great beast rouses at de door beneath de world. At last, a weapon for de Amani--one greater than any Zandalari loa. We just need de fuel to summon it.

Most of de warband is injured and isolated. Fallen soldiers will welcome de sight of you, expecting you to heal dem.

Take your dagger and do what must be done. Only you can save us, Nek'zali.
92934.title: Fuel the Calling

92935.description:
De ocean at our back slithers with tentacles and eyes, but we are safer there than on dis land. We were fools to think we could claim it from Kith'ix.

I have stood by your new obsession with rituals and superstitions, Nek'zali. Now, I need you to be de healer you once were.

Help my soldiers fight off de aqir. Buy us the time we need for de transport boats to arrive.
92935.title: Pushed to the Brink

92936.description:
Where is de rest of our warband?! De lines are breaking!

My soldiers will hold dem off as long as dey can. De weak should run. But you and I... if we die, let it be together with weapons in hand, sister.
92936.title: The Summoning of Ula'tek

92937.description:
Nek'zali, dat priestess... We should bring word of what we've seen back to de hash'ey.

Orweyna. Ay! Wait--what's wrong with her?
92937.title: Awakened Evil

92938.description:
The air is thick with restless spirits. But there's more--it is the goddess. Where her voice was once quiet, I can feel it is now raised in anguish. Like a scream of terror.

I fear for what we may find ahead.

I will follow her voice. Come. Together, we uncover her memories of this place.
92938.title: Site of Terror

92939.description:
{name}, I have something strange, here.

While scouting in the Storm Fields, I found this rock a beast was chewing. Look at it! Could these be runes? Writing?

But so ancient? Here? What could it mean?

Strangely, I think I've been hearing a voice in my head since I found this thing...

We must investigate further. Maybe we can find more of this rubble in the bellies of those beasts?
92939.title: It's Not Just a Rock!

92944.description:
There's no rubble on the surface. The beasts are burrowing, so they must be finding it in a cavern underground.

I've been thinking of how to get there.

You've noticed the vortexes that dot the Storm Fields? They twist space, moving things from place to place.

Step through one and I can reveal the anomalous residue that surrounds them.

Collect the residue and I can make a spell to redirect the portal to where the source of the rubble is!
92944.title: Sifting Through Void

92945.description:
These threats we chase are intelligent. Determined. Deadly.

Their ingenuity will seek to confound you. Their strength will seek to destroy you. It is from their very will to live--to predate--that we will extract the essence required to fuel the magical defenses of our city. 

I have had my assistants lay out our friend's toys. You'd do best to familiarize yourself with them.
92945.title: The Power of Anguish

92946.description:
We're at the brink of a monumental discovery! Hurry, there's no time to even call for backup. We must find this strange spirit!

With this residue, I can make a spell to adjust the vortex. It'll lead us to the source of this engraved rubble.

Based on the specter's guidance, I believe we'll find an entire cave.

Be ready, {name}.
92946.title: Buried in the Dark

92948.description:
Akintunde created a weapon to end all intelligent life on this world, eons and eons ago?

I hardly believe it.

But truth or lie, we can't leave this spirit be. He's clearly dangerous.

If he truly knows how to create such a weapon, we can't let him contact anyone from Azeroth. We both know a few warmongers who would do anything for that kind of power...

I think I can realign the vortex again to take us directly to Akintunde. Ready yourself for a fight, {name}.
92948.title: In Over My Head

92951.description:
De mask says we are lookin' for de scrolls of Malacrass. While we are in Maisara, try to find any scrolls de Vilebranch have left around.

Maisara is a dangerous place, so don't bother sortin' through dem--just grab 'em and we can check later.

Even if dey don't mention Ula'tek, we might find information about their plans or intentions against de Amani.
92951.title: Digging Deeper

92952.description:
De magic helped, but... not enough. I still don't remember my name or past life. Dat knowledge may be lost forever...

I do remember more about Ula'tek--or rather, where we might find more information!

I was forced into dis form by de Vilebranch trolls. Dey kept dark knowledge secret from de other tribes, includin' knowledge of Ula'tek.

If we are to know more, we must go to de Maisara Deeps.
92952.title: Mission to Maisara

92953.description:
While I was a servant of de Vilebranch, I remember discussions about Malacrass's research into Ula'tek.

Malacrass recorded his knowledge in scrolls that he kept with him. Now that he's dead, we need to find out what happened to dem.

De Vilebranch hex masters won't talk willingly... but if you slay dem, I can use their own necromantic magic against dem to compel dem to speak.
92953.title: Memories of Malacrass

92954.description:
Malacrass's notes are with Vordaza, and she's using them to further her necromantic experiments.

I need you to go into de Maisara Caverns to recover them. It will be dangerous, and you will need to gather allies before venturing in.

I will stay here and protect my uncle. We need to sort through all de scrolls we gathered and see what else we can find out.
92954.title: Maisara Caverns: Master of Souls

92955.description:
De ancestors did not bow to a loa--dey claimed a weapon! A weapon dat led to our victory.

I must know more.

You said de tablets at Numazon are de oldest in Zul'Aman. We can continue de search there. Perhaps de ancient Amani left behind clues for us.

Uncle says we should bring de mask. A stray memory might be de key to unlocking dis mystery.
92955.title: The Tablets of Numazon

92957.description:
If de tablets were made when de Amani first arrived in Zul'Aman, den there must be some clue about Ula'tek here.

De tablets are too heavy to carry, so Uncle suggested dat we take rubbings of de inscriptions.

I scouted ahead and gathered a few, but I ran into de Vilebranch. I came back here to make sure Uncle was safe.

Enter Numazon and collect more of de rubbings while I watch over Uncle. Watch out for de Vilebranch.
92957.title: There's the Rub

92958.description:
I wish I could be more help but... de gaps in my memory. Due to de damage de mask has sustained, dat magic has leaked out for who knows how long.

You repaired de physical parts of de mask, but de magic within is still weak.

Zul'jan says Vilebranch trolls occupy this crypt. De magic dat binds me together is like de magic they use.

You might be able to help. Retrieve their hex fetishes--I should be able to drain the magic from them.
92958.title: Brain Drain

93010.description:
Here! De note says Ula'tek was sealed away by de Amani. To break de seal, one needs a "key."

<Zul'jan flips through the notes.>

De key was hidden within a shrine and protected with ancient magic. But which shrine... 

<Zul'jan looks up.>

Didn't de tablets at Numazon mention a shrine bein' "dedicated to de serpent's victory?" We know from de visions in Harandar dat Ula'tek was a serpent. 

Dat must be it! De key is hidden at de serpent shrine in Atal'Aman!
93010.title: The Serpent Shrine

93011.description:
If Malacrass was right, de key to Ula'tek should be right here.

<Zul'jan's heavy hammer thumps onto the shrine for emphasis.>

It may take me some time to break through de stone to find it.

I don't know what kind of protection de ancestors have in place, but you will have to deal with dem while I work.

I admit, I did not believe de visions in Harandar. I don't fully trust Malacrass's notes either.

But if de key is here, dat would be undeniable proof dat what we are chasing is real.
93011.title: Legacy of the Amani

93012.description:
After the meeting in Harandar, I came here to speak with Zul'jarra about the vision you witnessed. Zul'jan had seemed upset when you left and it was not my intent to make him so.

But all of that can wait. Now that you're awake, you should go speak to Zul'jarra. She wants to know what happened at Atal'Aman.
93012.title: Dead End

93018.description:
My brother is here. And so are de captives.

Dey are bein' held in de small shrines ahead. For what, I don't know.

But somehow my brother is involved.

Gettin' my people free of dis place is of de highest priority. Do whatever is necessary to free dem.

Zul'jan can wait until de prisoners are safe.
93018.title: Them That Were Lost

93019.description:
<Zul'jarra's hand tightens on her axe.>

We knew de island was cursed, but is dis de curse? Or has what Zul'jan and Malacrass done brought dem here?

De answer doesn't matter. We must find and save de ones dey kidnapped--and find my brother.

<Zul'jarra surveys the island stretching out around her. Her eyes narrow.>

I see somethin' ahead. A structure. I'm gonna see if my people are there.

You protect de people here. Crush de serpents. Grind dem into de ground.

Meet me when you are done.
93019.title: Situation Normal, All Snaked Up

93022.description:
De prisoners need to be rescued, yes, but dis place is an abomination.

We must cleanse it with de spirit-born fire of Jan'alai.

Take dis totem. It will allow you to wield de breath of our loa.

Purge their nests. And kill de spiteful broodsisters that laid dem!
93022.title: Fire, the Only Way to Be Sure

93023.description:
Now only these creatures block our way to...

<Zul'jarra growls softly.>

...to Zul'jan.

Dey are protectin' him like he's one of dem. One of their army.

Whether he is or not, we gotta take dem down if we're gonna find out.
93023.title: Death of Furies

93024.description:
Stay here, hash'ura. I'm goin' in to talk to him.

Maybe I can talk him into leavin' on his own--and tellin' us what Malacrass has planned.

I hope to de loa that he will come to his senses.
93024.title: Come With Me

93043.description:
Such a strong will to survive, even when trapped in a cage. 

Do not underestimate your prey, {name}. They can strike at any time.

Our friend here will be more than willing to demonstrate, I am sure...
93043.title: When Predator Becomes Prey

93047.description:
We can't keep up with how much these soldiers eat. Lend us just a bit of your time to feed dis army, hm?

We need boar. Not just a steak or two, we need de entire boar. Nothin' goes to waste, yah?
93047.title: Butchery Basics

93048.description:
Dat boy Kovu stormed out of here without even tryin' a single step. He thinks he's got two left feet, but he isn't even willin' to try.

You look like an impressive fighter. He'll respect you for dat.

Maybe he just needs de right dance partner to show him de steps. Help him out, hm?
93048.title: Got No Rhythm

93049.description:
<The little girl keeps her voice low, making sure her father doesn't overhear.>

My friends are goin' out to play down where de shade lilies grow, but I'm supposed to do a buncha borin' apothecary stuff.

Papa wants me to collect some plants to make salves and balms we use for healin'. I asked if it could wait and he said no.

What if... you helped me out? Just dis once, pleeease?
93049.title: Homework Support

93050.description:
De altars need to be infused with de power of de loas every so often.

I'm not as spry as I used to be and de altars are all spread out.

Help an old shaman out, eh? I'll give you my totem to channel de loas' power into de altars.

And maybe you can learn a thing or two from de other acolytes and myself in de process.
93050.title: Altar History

93051.description:
My trainin' is almost complete!

My commander says I need to prove myself against a strong fighter before she can recommend me for combat.

But I've been strugglin' to find someone willin' to spar with me after... uh, after what happened de last time...

You look capable. And intimidatin'. Mind helpin' me out here?

And no goin' easy on me, yes? I can take it.
93051.title: The Final Exam

93055.description:
{name}, how fares your journey through this timeline?

Should you wish to explore history further, Khadgar and Eternus may be able to show you more quests that the champions of Azeroth previously experienced.
93055.title: Extracurriculars

93056.description:
You are exceeding expectations, {name}.

Even still, let us not tarry. I will teach you what I know so that we may expedite your journey.

However, all good things come with time. You are not yet ready for my strongest blessings.
93056.title: A Lesson in Alacrity

93057.description:
<A glowing parchment appears in front of you with the symbol of a home in front of it.>

Greetings, {name}!

Have you ever wanted to own a home? Have a place to call your own? Now you can!

Join us in Founder's Point, the new Housing Neighborhood. Get your very own slice of Azeroth!
93057.title: A House For You

93063.description:
De spirits, their weapons--I recognize dem! Dey are Amani: heroes and warriors from our murals and stories! Dis was de site of a great battle--one dat earned us de right to call dis land Zul'Aman. 

We should bring evidence of our history back to the others watchin' Zul'jarra, to remind 'em we got our ancestors watchin' over us.

Takin' de raised spirits' weapons may "raise some spirits" back at camp, no?
93063.title: Broken Spears

93064.description:
It's the priestess again--the one whose remains we found in the crypt.

These memories--no. Not memories. They are like nightmares. Something horrible befell the goddess. We must see it directly. Hear her song through all the noise.

I fear this vision will be too much for me alone. Join me, both of you, and let us witness the goddess' past terror.
93064.title: Awe of She

93093.description:
I was sent here to prove dat I am ready to be an Amani warrior. All dat want de honor must prove demselves.

I chose de gnarldin since dey are close now, and I heard Zul'jarra softened dem up a little.

Looks like I wasn't de only one who thought dat and was wrong.

But I still need to collect as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible.

If I have de bigshot hash'ura helpin' me, there's no way I can lose, no?

You get de trophies. I will stay behind to watch our backs.
93093.title: Gnarldin Trophies

93094.description:
Many warriors have chosen to face de gnarldin since dey came to Zul'Aman, but many have failed.

Dey thought now dat de gnarldin are in our territory and weakened, dey would be easier...

De gnarldin hunters have collected tablets from de Amani hunters dat fell here.

But with you at my side, we can get "vengeance" for those dat lost their lives here--no killin' or life riskin' required.

We don't have to kill de gnarldin. We just have to get close enough to gather de tablets. What do you say?
93094.title: Scavenged Victory

93095.description:
De leader of de gnarldin here is known as Tusk Taker. Take a wild guess why she's named dat.

There is a trophy dis one has in a cave. Take it, and she will run out rarin' for a fight.

Defeat her for me, and no one can challenge my right to be an Amani warrior.
93095.title: Bitter Fury

93096.description:
Dat is all de trophies we need.

I'll take dem to de meetin' point nearby. All we gotta do is wait there for Huntmaster Jinki to show up.

Come!
93096.title: Amani Honor
